quote: On the one hand, the high concentration of plasma ammonia elevated the excretory burden [ 46 ], and the mass of MDA elicited the oxidative stress [ 47 ]. They combinedly contributed to the high level of cortisol, whereby it can be affirmed that the new strain of preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone would confront with serious stress if its dietary protein was in excess.
statement: 一方面，高浓度的血浆氨增加了排泄负担，大量的MDA引发了氧化应激；它们共同导致了高水平的皮质醇，因此可以肯定，如果该新种三倍体鲫鱼的日粮蛋白过量，将面临严重的应激。
text_zh: 一方面，高浓度的血浆氨增加了排泄负担，大量的MDA引发了氧化应激；它们共同导致了高水平的皮质醇，因此可以肯定，如果该新种三倍体鲫鱼的日粮蛋白过量，将面临严重的应激。
text_en: On the one hand, high concentrations of plasma ammonia increased excretion burden, and large amounts of MDA triggered oxidative stress; together they led to high levels of cortisol. Therefore, it can be concluded that if the dietary protein is excessive for this new species of triploid crucian carp, it will face severe stress.

quote: It is pertinent to note that high dietary protein could increase the burden of ammonia excretion in the fish and further cause higher load to the water environment [ 46 ].
statement: 高膳食蛋白可能增加鱼类氨排泄负担，进而加重水环境负荷。
text_zh: 高膳食蛋白可能增加鱼类氨排泄负担，进而加重水环境负荷。
text_en: High dietary protein may increase the burden of ammonia excretion in fish, thereby aggravating the load on the water environment.

quote: The present study showed that the new strain of preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone fed with excessive protein might get into a weak antioxidative status.
statement: 本研究表明，饲喂过量蛋白的新种优势四倍体鲫鱼克隆系可能进入弱抗氧化状态。
text_zh: 本研究表明，饲喂过量蛋白的新种优势四倍体鲫鱼克隆系可能进入弱抗氧化状态。
text_en: This study indicates that the new heterosis tetraploid crucian carp clone line fed excess protein may enter a weak antioxidant state.

quote: High dietary protein dimmed the activity of CAT and increased the content of MDA in the liver, agreeing with many other reports that the contents of liver MDA was negatively correlated to the CAT activity.
statement: 高膳食蛋白降低了肝脏CAT活性并增加了MDA含量，这与许多其他报告一致，即肝脏MDA含量与CAT活性呈负相关。
text_zh: 高膳食蛋白降低了肝脏CAT活性并增加了MDA含量，这与许多其他报告一致，即肝脏MDA含量与CAT活性呈负相关。
text_en: High dietary protein decreased liver CAT activity and increased MDA content, which is consistent with many other reports that liver MDA content is negatively correlated with CAT activity.

quote: It meant that too much dietary protein might weaken the antioxidative status of the fish and led to an accumulation of peroxides [ 47 – 49 ].
statement: 这意味着过多的膳食蛋白可能会削弱鱼类的抗氧化状态并导致过氧化物积累。
text_zh: 这意味着过多的膳食蛋白可能会削弱鱼类的抗氧化状态并导致过氧化物积累。
text_en: This means that excessive dietary protein may weaken the antioxidant status of fish and lead to peroxide accumulation.

quote: Other studies concerning different dietary amino acid, lipid, or carbohydrate levels also suggested that exorbitant nutrients in diet would induce more production of MDA [ 50 – 52 ].
statement: 关于不同膳食氨基酸、脂质或碳水化合物水平的其他研究也表明，饮食中过量的营养素会诱导更多的MDA产生。
text_zh: 关于不同膳食氨基酸、脂质或碳水化合物水平的其他研究也表明，饮食中过量的营养素会诱导更多的MDA产生。
text_en: Other studies on different dietary amino acid, lipid, or carbohydrate levels also indicate that excess nutrients in the diet induce more MDA production.

quote: And a study on crayfish (Procambarus clarkia) showed that the liver antioxidative capacity was degraded whether dietary protein level was high or low [ 53 ].
statement: 一项关于克氏原螯虾的研究显示，无论膳食蛋白水平是高还是低，肝脏抗氧化能力均下降。
text_zh: 一项关于克氏原螯虾的研究显示，无论膳食蛋白水平是高还是低，肝脏抗氧化能力均下降。
text_en: A study on red swamp crayfish showed that liver antioxidant capacity decreased regardless of whether dietary protein levels were high or low.

quote: But the present study revealed that low dietary protein of 21.38% did not show harmful effects based on the measured parameters.
statement: 但本研究揭示，基于测量参数，21.38%的低膳食蛋白未显示出有害影响。
text_zh: 但本研究揭示，基于测量参数，21.38%的低膳食蛋白未显示出有害影响。
text_en: However, this study revealed that, based on measured parameters, 21.38% low dietary protein did not show harmful effects.

population.species: new strain of preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone

quote: The difference illustrated that low dietary protein was enough to maintain a sound antioxidation of the new strain of preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone.
statement: 这种差异说明低膳食蛋白足以维持新种优势四倍体鲫鱼克隆系的良好抗氧化性。
text_zh: 这种差异说明低膳食蛋白足以维持新种优势四倍体鲫鱼克隆系的良好抗氧化性。
text_en: This difference indicates that low dietary protein is sufficient to maintain good antioxidant capacity in the clonal line of the new dominant tetraploid crucian carp.

population.species: new strain of preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone

quote: Table 1. Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of the JL strain of Saprolegnia to 20 Chinese herb extracts (7 × 107 spores/ml).
statement: 表1列出了JL菌株水霉对20种中草药提取物的最低抑菌浓度（MIC）。
text_zh: 表1列出了JL菌株水霉对20种中草药提取物的最低抑菌浓度（MIC）。
text_en: Table 1 lists the minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) of 20 herbal medicine extracts against JL strain Saprolegnia.

quote: Overall, the dietary protein content for the preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone was supposed to be ranged in 21.38%–30.56%.
statement: 总体而言，优势型三倍体鲫克隆体的膳食蛋白含量应控制在21.38%至30.56%之间。
text_zh: 总体而言，优势型三倍体鲫克隆体的膳食蛋白含量应控制在21.38%至30.56%之间。
text_en: Overall, the dietary protein content for dominant-type triploid crucian carp clones should be controlled between 21.38% and 30.56%.

quote: The reduced PRE in high dietary protein groups could be accounted for the activities of liver ALT and the contents of plasma ammonia [ 41 ].
statement: 高膳食蛋白组中蛋白质保留效率（PRE）降低可归因于肝脏ALT活性和血浆氨含量的变化。
text_zh: 高膳食蛋白组中蛋白质保留效率（PRE）降低可归因于肝脏ALT活性和血浆氨含量的变化。
text_en: The decrease in protein retention efficiency (PRE) in the high dietary protein group may be attributed to changes in liver ALT activity and plasma ammonia content.
outcome: 肝脏代谢压力/血液指标

quote: In this study, fish liver ALT activity increased with dietary protein levels,
statement: 在本研究中，鱼肝脏ALT活性随膳食蛋白水平的增加而升高。
text_zh: 在本研究中，鱼肝脏ALT活性随膳食蛋白水平的增加而升高。
text_en: In this study, fish liver ALT activity increased with increasing dietary protein levels.

population.species: fish (implied from context: new strain/amphitriploid Carassius clone)

quote: The present study showed no significantly difference liver AST activity among treatments,
statement: 本研究表明各处理组间肝脏AST活性无显著差异。
text_zh: 本研究表明各处理组间肝脏AST活性无显著差异。
text_en: This study showed no significant difference in liver AST activity among the treatment groups.

quote: Alanine and aspartate are both gluconeogenic amino acids, but quantitatively, alanine is the most important, and this might explain why ALT was affected by the dietary treatment but AST was not [ 44 ].
statement: 丙氨酸和天冬氨酸都是糖异生氨基酸，但在数量上丙氨酸最重要，这可能解释了为什么ALT受膳食处理影响而AST未受影响。
text_zh: 丙氨酸和天冬氨酸都是糖异生氨基酸，但在数量上丙氨酸最重要，这可能解释了为什么ALT受膳食处理影响而AST未受影响。
text_en: Alanine and aspartate are both gluconeogenic amino acids, but alanine is the most important in quantity, which may explain why ALT was affected by dietary treatment while AST was not.

quote: According to Cai, Wermerskirchen, and Adelman [ 45 ] findings, ammonia excretion could indicate dietary protein adequacy for fish.
statement: 根据Cai等人的发现，氨排泄可以指示鱼类膳食蛋白的充足性。
text_zh: 根据Cai等人的发现，氨排泄可以指示鱼类膳食蛋白的充足性。
text_en: According to the findings of Cai et al., ammonia excretion can indicate the adequacy of dietary protein in fish.

quote: The current study found that plasma ammonia was extremely high in the fish fed the diet contained excessive protein.
statement: 当前研究发现，喂食含有过量蛋白质饲料的鱼的血浆氨含量极高。
text_zh: 当前研究发现，喂食含有过量蛋白质饲料的鱼的血浆氨含量极高。
text_en: Current research has found that fish fed diets containing excess protein have extremely high plasma ammonia levels.

quote: Yang, Liou, and Liu [ 40 ] reported that the amount of postprandial ammonia excreted by silver perch (Bidyanus bidyanus) was positively correlated with dietary protein level.
statement: Yang等人报道，银鲈餐后排出的氨量与膳食蛋白水平呈正相关。
text_zh: Yang等人报道，银鲈餐后排出的氨量与膳食蛋白水平呈正相关。
text_en: Yang et al. reported that ammonia excretion after feeding in silver perch was positively correlated with dietary protein levels.

quote: It could owe to the fact that low-protein diets promoted feed intake and the attendant increase ingestion of lipid and carbohydrate resulted in high body fat [ 66 ].
statement: 这可能归因于低蛋白日粮促进了摄食量，随之增加的脂质和碳水化合物摄入导致高体脂。
text_zh: 这可能归因于低蛋白日粮促进了摄食量，随之增加的脂质和碳水化合物摄入导致高体脂。
text_en: This may be attributed to the low-protein diet promoting feed intake, with the subsequent increase in lipid and carbohydrate intake leading to high body fat.

quote: In the findings of Guo et al. [ 68 ], glycolysis and lipid synthesis was upregulated after fish were fed with lower-protein diet, thus leading to no impact on glycemia and a boost on blood fat.
statement: 在Guo等人的发现中，鱼饲喂较低蛋白日粮后糖酵解和脂质合成上调，从而导致对血糖无影响并提高了血脂。
text_zh: 在Guo等人的发现中，鱼饲喂较低蛋白日粮后糖酵解和脂质合成上调，从而导致对血糖无影响并提高了血脂。
text_en: In the findings of Guo et al., feeding fish a lower-protein diet upregulated glycolysis and lipid synthesis, resulting in no effect on blood glucose and increased blood lipids.
outcome: 代谢途径（糖酵解、脂质合成）

quote: Hematological parameters were prevalently used to reflect systemic physiological and metabolic and health status [ 69 ].
statement: 血液学参数常被用于反映全身生理、代谢和健康状况。
text_zh: 血液学参数常被用于反映全身生理、代谢和健康状况。
text_en: Hematological parameters are often used to reflect overall physiological, metabolic, and health status.

quote: We collected 0.5–1 mL blood from the caudal vein of each individual using a syringe containing ~200–400 U sodium heparin.
statement: 使用含有约200-400单位肝素钠的注射器从每个个体的尾静脉采集0.5-1毫升血液。
text_zh: 使用含有约200-400单位肝素钠的注射器从每个个体的尾静脉采集0.5-1毫升血液。
text_en: 0.5-1 ml of blood was collected from the caudal vein of each individual using a syringe containing about 200-400 units of heparin sodium.

quote: However, Arg is a beneficial feed supplementation to enhance fish growth and immune response, and research on the use of Arg as a feed supplementation for the health and welfare of Gibel carp is limited.
statement: 然而，精氨酸是一种有益的饲料补充剂，可增强鱼类的生长和免疫反应，但关于将精氨酸用作银鲫健康和福利的饲料补充剂的研究有限。
text_zh: 然而，精氨酸是一种有益的饲料补充剂，可增强鱼类的生长和免疫反应，但关于将精氨酸用作银鲫健康和福利的饲料补充剂的研究有限。
text_en: However, arginine is a beneficial feed supplement that enhances fish growth and immune responses, but there is limited research on using arginine as a feed supplement for the health and welfare of silver crucian carp.
outcome: 生长, 免疫反应, 健康与福利

quote: this study will attempt to determine if Arg supplementation can improve growth, immune responses, antioxidative stress, and oxygen-carrying capacity in this species.
statement: 本研究旨在确定精氨酸补充是否能改善该物种的生长、免疫反应、抗氧化应激和携氧能力。
text_zh: 本研究旨在确定精氨酸补充是否能改善该物种的生长、免疫反应、抗氧化应激和携氧能力。
text_en: This study aimed to determine whether arginine supplementation improves growth, immune response, antioxidant stress, and oxygen-carrying capacity in this species.
outcome: 生长、免疫、抗氧化应激及携氧能力

quote: The base level of Arg in the feed is 2.19%, which meets the Arg requirement of juvenile Gibel carp at 2.0% [ 36 ].
statement: 饲料中精氨酸的基础水平为2.19%，满足幼鲫2.0%的精氨酸需求。
text_zh: 饲料中精氨酸的基础水平为2.19%，满足幼鲫2.0%的精氨酸需求。
text_en: The basal level of arginine in the feed was 2.19%, meeting the 2.0% arginine requirement for juvenile crucian carp.

quote: Figure 2 Quadratic regression model analysis of feed conversion ratio (FCR) against graded different supplementation levels of Arg.
statement: 图2展示了饲料系数（FCR）与不同精氨酸添加水平之间的二次回归模型分析。
text_zh: 图2展示了饲料系数（FCR）与不同精氨酸添加水平之间的二次回归模型分析。
text_en: Figure 2 shows the quadratic regression model analysis between feed conversion ratio (FCR) and different arginine supplementation levels.

quote: The 0.6% and 0.8% Arg supplementation groups showed ALT levels that were significantly higher than the 0% (control) group
statement: 添加0.6%和0.8%精氨酸的组别，其血浆ALT水平显著高于对照组（0%）。
text_zh: 添加0.6%和0.8%精氨酸的组别，其血浆ALT水平显著高于对照组（0%）。
text_en: Groups supplemented with 0.6% and 0.8% arginine had plasma ALT levels significantly higher than the control group (0%).

quote: The eight-week feeding trial used a satiety feeding strategy (stop coming up to feed).
statement: 八周的饲养试验采用饱食投喂策略（停止上浮摄食即停喂）。
text_zh: 八周的饲养试验采用饱食投喂策略（停止上浮摄食即停喂）。
text_en: An eight-week feeding trial used a satiation feeding strategy (feeding stopped when fish ceased to feed at the surface).

quote: Gibel carp were given two equal meals twice daily at 7 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.
statement: Fish were fed two equal meals per day at specific times (7 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.).
text_en: Fish were fed two equal meals per day at specific times (7 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.).

quote: the range of water temperature was 28–32 °C, the pH was 7.0–7.8, the dissolved oxygen concentration remained at 6.0–7.8 mg/L, and the ammonia nitrogen content was less than 0.1 mg/L.
statement: Water quality parameters including temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, and ammonia nitrogen were monitored and maintained within specified ranges throughout the trial.
text_en: Water quality parameters including temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, and ammonia nitrogen were monitored and maintained within specified ranges throughout the trial.

quote: Before sampling, the fish were starved for twenty-four hours.
statement: Fish underwent a 24-hour starvation period prior to sampling.
text_en: Fish underwent a 24-hour starvation period prior to sampling.

quote: The fish specimens were rendered unconscious using MS-222 (100 mg/L) before obtaining liver and blood samples.
statement: Fish were anesthetized with MS-222 at 100 mg/L to induce unconsciousness before tissue sampling.
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with MS-222 at 100 mg/L to induce unconsciousness before tissue sampling.

quote: However, with the fast development of high-density and intensive aquaculture models, aquaculture is facing many challenges. The likelihood of decreased immunity and hypoxia affecting live aquatic organisms has increased significantly [ 2 ].
statement: 高密度集约化养殖模式导致水生生物免疫力下降和缺氧的可能性显著增加。
text_zh: 高密度集约化养殖模式导致水生生物免疫力下降和缺氧的可能性显著增加。
text_en: High-density intensive farming significantly increases the likelihood of decreased immunity and hypoxia in aquatic organisms.

quote: Scientists have attempted to reverse this situation through the extensive use of antibiotics and other medicines [ 3 , 4 ]. However, many of these medicines are no longer suitable for aquaculture owing to increasing environmental pressures and restrictions on antibiotic use.
statement: 科学家曾尝试通过大量使用抗生素和其他药物来改善情况，但由于环境压力和抗生素使用的限制，许多此类药物已不再适合用于水产养殖。
text_zh: 科学家曾尝试通过大量使用抗生素和其他药物来改善情况，但由于环境压力和抗生素使用的限制，许多此类药物已不再适合用于水产养殖。
text_en: Scientists have attempted to improve the situation through the heavy use of antibiotics and other drugs, but due to environmental pressures and restrictions on antibiotic use, many such drugs are no longer suitable for aquaculture.
outcome: 疾病控制与环境可持续性
limitations: 环境压力增加和抗生素使用限制

quote: Thus, nutritional modification is an important way to boost fish immune systems and reduce the risk of disease [ 5 ].
statement: 营养调控是增强鱼类免疫系统并降低疾病风险的重要途径。
text_zh: 营养调控是增强鱼类免疫系统并降低疾病风险的重要途径。
text_en: Nutritional regulation is an important approach to enhancing the immune system of fish and reducing disease risk.

quote: Adding 1% Arg to feed significantly enhanced the final body weight (FBW), specific growth rate (SGR), feed conversion rate (FCR), and survival rate (SR) of hybrid striped bass (Morone saxatilis) [ 14 ].
statement: 在饲料中添加1%的精氨酸显著提高了杂交条纹鲈的最终体重、特定生长率、饲料转化率和存活率。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加1%的精氨酸显著提高了杂交条纹鲈的最终体重、特定生长率、饲料转化率和存活率。
text_en: Adding 1% arginine to the feed significantly improved the final body weight, specific growth rate, feed conversion ratio, and survival rate of hybrid striped bass.

quote: il-10 mRNA expression to increase; however, there was no significant difference compared to the control group
statement: il-10 mRNA表达增加，但与对照组相比无显著差异。
text_zh: il-10 mRNA表达增加，但与对照组相比无显著差异。
text_en: IL-10 mRNA expression increased, but there was no significant difference compared to the control group.

quote: The il-1β and nf-κb mRNA expression showed no significant difference compared to the control group
statement: il-1β和nf-κb mRNA表达与对照组相比无显著差异。
text_zh: il-1β和nf-κb mRNA表达与对照组相比无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in IL-1β and NF-κB mRNA expression compared to the control group.

quote: There was no statistical difference in tnf-α and il-8 mRNA expression across the groups
statement: 各组间tnf-α和il-8 mRNA表达无统计学差异。
text_zh: 各组间tnf-α和il-8 mRNA表达无统计学差异。
text_en: There was no statistically significant difference in tnf-α and il-8 mRNA expression between groups.

quote: An eight-week trial was designed to study the effects of arginine (Arg) supplemented diets on the growth, immunity, antioxidant activity, and oxygen-carrying capacity of juvenile Gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio).
statement: 一项为期八周的试验旨在研究补充精氨酸日粮对鲫鱼幼鱼生长、免疫、抗氧化活性和携氧能力的影响。
text_zh: 一项为期八周的试验旨在研究补充精氨酸日粮对鲫鱼幼鱼生长、免疫、抗氧化活性和携氧能力的影响。
text_en: An eight-week trial aimed to study the effects of arginine-supplemented diets on the growth, immunity, antioxidant activity, and oxygen-carrying capacity of juvenile crucian carp.
outcome: 生长、免疫、抗氧化活性及携氧能力

quote: The results showed that final body weight (FBW), weight gain rate (WGR), and specific growth rate (SGR) all increased and then declined with increasing levels of Arg supplementation, while feed conversion ratio (FCR) showed the opposite trend.
statement: 结果显示，随着精氨酸添加水平的增加，终末体重、增重率和特定生长率先升后降，而饲料转化率呈现相反趋势。
text_zh: 结果显示，随着精氨酸添加水平的增加，终末体重、增重率和特定生长率先升后降，而饲料转化率呈现相反趋势。
text_en: The results showed that as the arginine supplementation level increased, final body weight, weight gain rate, and specific growth rate first increased and then decreased, while feed conversion ratio showed the opposite trend.
counterevidence: 高剂量精氨酸导致生长指标下降

quote: Supplementation with 0.6% and 0.8% Arg significantly increased plasma alanine transaminase (ALT) activity
statement: 补充0.6%和0.8%的精氨酸显著增加了血浆丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性。
text_zh: 补充0.6%和0.8%的精氨酸显著增加了血浆丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性。
text_en: Supplementation with 0.6% and 0.8% arginine significantly increased plasma alanine aminotransferase (ALT) activity.
counterevidence: 高剂量精氨酸可能引起肝损伤标志物升高

quote: while catalase (CAT) activity was significantly increased with 0.4% Arg supplementation levels
statement: 而在0.4%精氨酸补充水平下，过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性显著增加。
text_zh: 而在0.4%精氨酸补充水平下，过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性显著增加。
text_en: At the 0.4% arginine supplementation level, catalase (CAT) activity increased significantly.

quote: Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) fed Arg-supplemented diets have shown a trend toward higher specific feed rate (SFR) and specific growth rate (SGR) and increased final body weight [ 16 ].
statement: 喂食补充精氨酸日粮的大西洋鲑表现出比摄食率和特定生长率提高的趋势，且最终体重增加。
text_zh: 喂食补充精氨酸日粮的大西洋鲑表现出比摄食率和特定生长率提高的趋势，且最终体重增加。
text_en: Atlantic salmon fed arginine-supplemented diets showed a trend of increased feed intake and specific growth rate, and increased final body weight.

quote: Appropriate Arg levels stimulate non-specific immunity and improve disease resistance and fish survival [ 21 ].
statement: 适宜水平的精氨酸刺激非特异性免疫，改善疾病抵抗力和鱼类存活率。
text_zh: 适宜水平的精氨酸刺激非特异性免疫，改善疾病抵抗力和鱼类存活率。
text_en: Appropriate levels of arginine stimulate non-specific immunity, improve disease resistance and fish survival rates.

quote: As the only substrate for NO synthesis, Arg could regulate the NF-κB pathway by mediating toll-like receptors (TLRs) and then inhibit the expression of inflammatory response-related genes, such as tumor necrosis factor-α (tnf-α) and interleukin-1β (il-1β) [ 22 , 23 , 24 ].
statement: 作为NO合成的唯一底物，精氨酸可通过介导Toll样受体调节NF-κB通路，进而抑制肿瘤坏死因子-α和白细胞介素-1β等炎症反应相关基因的表达。
text_zh: 作为NO合成的唯一底物，精氨酸可通过介导Toll样受体调节NF-κB通路，进而抑制肿瘤坏死因子-α和白细胞介素-1β等炎症反应相关基因的表达。
text_en: As the sole substrate for NO synthesis, arginine can regulate the NF-κB pathway by mediating Toll-like receptors, thereby inhibiting the expression of inflammation-related genes such as tumor necrosis factor-α and interleukin-1β.

quote: Furthermore, Arg is essential for the antioxidant capacity of fish; it can activate the Nrf2 signaling pathway, upregulating the expression of nrf2 and reducing oxidative stress [ 25 ].
statement: 此外，精氨酸对鱼类的抗氧化能力至关重要；它可以激活Nrf2信号通路，上调nrf2表达并减少氧化应激。
text_zh: 此外，精氨酸对鱼类的抗氧化能力至关重要；它可以激活Nrf2信号通路，上调nrf2表达并减少氧化应激。
text_en: In addition, arginine is essential for the antioxidant capacity of fish; it can activate the Nrf2 signaling pathway, upregulate nrf2 expression and reduce oxidative stress.

quote: Activation of this pathway upregulates antioxidant genes such as superoxide dismutase (sod), catalase (cat), and glutathione peroxidase (gpx) [ 26 ] and enhances the antioxidant capacity of Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var.Jian) [ 27 ], grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) [ 25 ], and blunt snout bream (Megalobrama amblycephala) [ 28 ].
statement: 该通路的激活上调了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶等抗氧化基因，并增强了建鲤、草鱼和团头鲂的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 该通路的激活上调了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶等抗氧化基因，并增强了建鲤、草鱼和团头鲂的抗氧化能力。
text_en: Activation of this pathway upregulated antioxidant genes such as superoxide dismutase, catalase, and glutathione peroxidase, and enhanced the antioxidant capacity of Jian carp, grass carp, and blunt snout bream.

population.species: Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var.Jian), grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella), blunt snout bream (Megalobrama amblycephala)

quote: Before the formal trials, the fish were fed general meals (Tong-Wei, Wuxi, China) for two weeks to acclimate them to their surroundings.
statement: 在正式试验前，鱼被喂食通用饲料两周以适应周围环境。
text_zh: 在正式试验前，鱼被喂食通用饲料两周以适应周围环境。
text_en: Before the formal trial, fish were fed a general diet for two weeks to acclimate to the surrounding environment.
intervention_record: 预适应期投喂通用饲料

quote: Three hundred healthy juvenile Gibel carp with an initial weight of 27.53 (±0.03 g) were randomly distributed into 15 nets (1 m × 1 m × 1 m) with 20 fish in each cage stochastically.
statement: 三百条健康的鲫鱼幼鱼被随机分配到15个网箱中，每个网箱20条鱼。
text_zh: 三百条健康的鲫鱼幼鱼被随机分配到15个网箱中，每个网箱20条鱼。
text_en: Three hundred healthy crucian carp juveniles were randomly assigned to 15 net cages, with 20 fish per cage.

quote: The water’s temperature and pH were measured daily throughout the trial: the range of water temperature was 28–32 °C, the pH was 7.0–7.8
statement: 整个试验期间每天测量水温及pH值，水温范围为28–32°C，pH值为7.0–7.8。
text_zh: 整个试验期间每天测量水温及pH值，水温范围为28–32°C，pH值为7.0–7.8。
text_en: Water temperature and pH were measured daily throughout the entire trial period, with water temperatures ranging from 28–32°C and pH values of 7.0–7.8.

quote: Arg plays an important role in improving the growth, antioxidant capacity, and immune capacity of juvenile Gibel carp.
statement: 精氨酸在改善幼年鲫鱼的生长、抗氧化能力和免疫能力方面发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 精氨酸在改善幼年鲫鱼的生长、抗氧化能力和免疫能力方面发挥重要作用。
text_en: Arginine plays an important role in improving the growth, antioxidant capacity and immune function of juvenile crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力、免疫能力

quote: ALT reached its maximum in the 0.8% Arg supplementation group, and AST did not differ between groups, possibly because of vigorous metabolism in the body due to Arg supplementation rather than liver injury [ 57 ] because AST and ALT also play an important role in
statement: 丙氨酸氨基转移酶在0.8%精氨酸补充组达到最大值，天冬氨酸氨基转移酶在各组间无差异，这可能是由于精氨酸补充引起的体内旺盛代谢而非肝损伤。
text_zh: 丙氨酸氨基转移酶在0.8%精氨酸补充组达到最大值，天冬氨酸氨基转移酶在各组间无差异，这可能是由于精氨酸补充引起的体内旺盛代谢而非肝损伤。
text_en: Alanine aminotransferase reached its maximum value in the 0.8% arginine supplementation group, while aspartate aminotransferase showed no significant difference among groups; this may be due to vigorous metabolism induced by arginine supplementation rather than liver damage.

quote: In this study, ALB did not show significant changes
statement: 在本研究中，白蛋白（ALB）未显示显著变化。
text_zh: 在本研究中，白蛋白（ALB）未显示显著变化。
text_en: In this study, albumin (ALB) did not show significant changes.
outcome: 营养状况/血浆蛋白水平

quote: nrf2 mRNA and κeap1 mRNA expression levels were simultaneously upregulated in the 0.8% Arg supplementation group compared with the control group, indicating that the Nrf2 antioxidant system can only be activated when the supplementation level of Arg reaches a certain level.
statement: 与对照组相比，0.8%精氨酸补充组的nrf2 mRNA和κeap1 mRNA表达水平同时上调，表明只有当精氨酸补充量达到一定水平时，Nrf2抗氧化系统才能被激活。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，0.8%精氨酸补充组的nrf2 mRNA和κeap1 mRNA表达水平同时上调，表明只有当精氨酸补充量达到一定水平时，Nrf2抗氧化系统才能被激活。
text_en: Compared with the control group, nrf2 mRNA and keap1 mRNA expression levels were simultaneously upregulated in the 0.8% arginine supplementation group, indicating that the Nrf2 antioxidant system can only be activated when the arginine supplementation level reaches a certain threshold.

quote: gpx and sod mRNA levels were highest in the 0.8% Arg supplementation group. Our results showed a dose-dependency rise in the gpx and sod gene expression, which indicates that high levels of Arg increased the antioxidant functions of Gibel carp
statement: 谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPX）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的mRNA水平在0.8%精氨酸补充组中最高，结果显示这两种基因的表达呈剂量依赖性上升，表明高水平的精氨酸增加了鲫鱼的抗氧化功能。
text_zh: 谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPX）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的mRNA水平在0.8%精氨酸补充组中最高，结果显示这两种基因的表达呈剂量依赖性上升，表明高水平的精氨酸增加了鲫鱼的抗氧化功能。
text_en: The mRNA levels of glutathione peroxidase (GPX) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) were highest in the 0.8% arginine supplementation group, showing a dose-dependent increase in the expression of these two genes, indicating that high levels of arginine increased the antioxidant function of crucian carp.

quote: In the present study, Arg feed supplementation increased CAT activity but did not have any significant effect on SOD activity in the liver.
statement: 在本研究中，精氨酸饲料补充增加了肝脏中的过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性，但对超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性没有显著影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，精氨酸饲料补充增加了肝脏中的过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性，但对超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性没有显著影响。
text_en: In this study, arginine feed supplementation increased catalase (CAT) activity in the liver but had no significant effect on superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity.

quote: Increased hif-1α downstream gene expression facilitates adaptation to hypoxia and improves hypoxia tolerance in the doughnut bream [ 32 ].
statement: hif-1α下游基因表达的增加有助于适应缺氧并提高鳊鱼的耐缺氧能力。
text_zh: hif-1α下游基因表达的增加有助于适应缺氧并提高鳊鱼的耐缺氧能力。
text_en: The increase in the expression of hif-1α downstream genes helps adapt to hypoxia and improves the hypoxia tolerance of bream.

quote: However, with changes in the culture environment, Gibel carp is highly susceptible to stress and other effects in culture.
statement: 然而，随着养殖环境的变化，银鲫在养殖过程中极易受到应激和其他影响。
text_zh: 然而，随着养殖环境的变化，银鲫在养殖过程中极易受到应激和其他影响。
text_en: However, with changes in the farming environment, silver crucian carp are highly susceptible to stress and other effects during the farming process.

quote: Therefore, finding the right supplements to add to animal feed could improve animal health; in addition, there have been a few studies on feed supplementation for Gibel carp [ 33 , 34 , 35 ].
statement: 因此，寻找合适的饲料添加剂可以改善动物健康；此外，关于银鲫饲料补充的研究有一些。
text_zh: 因此，寻找合适的饲料添加剂可以改善动物健康；此外，关于银鲫饲料补充的研究有一些。
text_en: Therefore, finding suitable feed additives can improve animal health; in addition, there is some research on silver crucian carp feed supplementation.

quote: Food conversion ratio (FCR) was significantly lower than the control group.
statement: 饲料转化率（FCR）显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 饲料转化率（FCR）显著低于对照组。
text_en: The feed conversion ratio (FCR) was significantly lower than that of the control group.

quote: cat mRNA expression, which showed the same trend (p > 0.05).
statement: cat mRNA表达显示出相同的趋势，但差异不显著（p > 0.05）。
text_zh: cat mRNA表达显示出相同的趋势，但差异不显著（p > 0.05）。
text_en: Cat mRNA expression showed the same trend, but the difference was not significant (p > 0.05).

quote: In this study, Arg-supplemented diets improved the growth performance and feed efficiency of juvenile Gibel carp.
statement: 在本研究中，添加精氨酸的日粮改善了鲫鱼幼鱼的生长性能和饲料效率。
text_zh: 在本研究中，添加精氨酸的日粮改善了鲫鱼幼鱼的生长性能和饲料效率。
text_en: In this study, arginine-supplemented diets improved the growth performance and feed efficiency of juvenile crucian carp.

quote: Fish can adapt to prolonged exposure to hypoxia by increasing blood volume with hemoglobin affinity [ 78 ], indicating that Arg supplementation might improve their hypoxia tolerance and the ability to transport oxygen.
statement: 鱼类可以通过增加具有血红蛋白亲和力的血容量来适应长期缺氧暴露，这表明精氨酸补充可能提高其耐缺氧能力和氧气运输能力。
text_zh: 鱼类可以通过增加具有血红蛋白亲和力的血容量来适应长期缺氧暴露，这表明精氨酸补充可能提高其耐缺氧能力和氧气运输能力。
text_en: Fish can adapt to long-term hypoxia exposure by increasing blood volume with hemoglobin affinity, suggesting that arginine supplementation may improve their hypoxia tolerance and oxygen transport capacity.

quote: adding exogenous Arg supplementation at 0.4–0.6% positively affected the growth, antioxidant capacity, and immune capacity of juvenile Gibel carp, with some dose-dependency.
statement: 添加0.4–0.6%的外源精氨酸补充剂对异育银鲫幼鱼的生长、抗氧化能力和免疫能力产生了积极影响，并表现出一定的剂量依赖性。
text_zh: 添加0.4–0.6%的外源精氨酸补充剂对异育银鲫幼鱼的生长、抗氧化能力和免疫能力产生了积极影响，并表现出一定的剂量依赖性。
text_en: Adding 0.4–0.6% exogenous arginine supplementation had a positive effect on the growth, antioxidant capacity, and immune capacity of juvenile allogynogenetic gibel carp, showing a certain dose-dependent effect.
outcome: 生长性能/抗氧化能力/免疫能力

quote: Feed quality and feeding methods therefore need to be thoroughly considered in order to improve growth performance and feed efficiency.
statement: 饲料质量和投喂方法需要被仔细考虑，以改善生长性能和饲料效率。
text_zh: 饲料质量和投喂方法需要被仔细考虑，以改善生长性能和饲料效率。
text_en: Feed quality and feeding methods need to be carefully considered to improve growth performance and feed efficiency.

quote: These results agree with those for juvenile golden pompan (Trachinotus ovatus) [ 51 ] and juvenile Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) [ 52 ].
statement: 这些结果与卵形鲳鲹幼鱼和尼罗罗非鱼幼鱼的研究结果一致。
text_zh: 这些结果与卵形鲳鲹幼鱼和尼罗罗非鱼幼鱼的研究结果一致。
text_en: These results are consistent with the findings from studies on juvenile golden pompano and juvenile Nile tilapia.

quote: Now a day’s probiotics have been employed as dietary supplement to enhance fish growth and improve resistance against disease at every stage.
statement: 益生菌作为膳食补充剂被用于增强鱼类生长并提高各阶段的疾病抵抗力。
text_zh: 益生菌作为膳食补充剂被用于增强鱼类生长并提高各阶段的疾病抵抗力。
text_en: Probiotics are used as dietary supplements to enhance fish growth and improve disease resistance at all stages.

quote: Probiotics are considered as microbes to be administered deliberately to improve gut flora, health of host and to withstand acidity of stomach, bile salts and anti-microbial compounds
statement: 益生菌被认为是故意施用的微生物，旨在改善肠道菌群、宿主健康以及耐受胃酸、胆盐和抗菌化合物。
text_zh: 益生菌被认为是故意施用的微生物，旨在改善肠道菌群、宿主健康以及耐受胃酸、胆盐和抗菌化合物。
text_en: Probiotics are considered intentionally administered microorganisms aimed at improving gut microbiota, host health, and tolerance to stomach acid, bile salts, and antimicrobial compounds.

quote: The poor culturists now use various chemicals or disinfectants and antibiotics to get rid of the disease outbreaks.
statement: 贫困的养殖者目前使用各种化学品、消毒剂或抗生素来消除疾病爆发。
text_zh: 贫困的养殖者目前使用各种化学品、消毒剂或抗生素来消除疾病爆发。
text_en: Poor farmers currently use various chemicals, disinfectants or antibiotics to eliminate disease outbreaks.

quote: Growth, immune response and resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila of juvenile yellow catfish, Pelteobagrus fulvidraco, fed diets with different arginine levels.
statement: 不同精氨酸水平的日粮影响黄颡鱼幼鱼的生长、免疫反应和对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_zh: 不同精氨酸水平的日粮影响黄颡鱼幼鱼的生长、免疫反应和对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_en: Diets with different arginine levels affect the growth, immune response, and resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila of juvenile yellow catfish.

quote: Effects of dietary arginine and glutamine on growth performance, immune responses and intestinal structure of red drum, Sciaenops ocellatus.
statement: 日粮精氨酸和谷氨酰胺影响红鼓鱼的生长性能、免疫反应和肠道结构。
text_zh: 日粮精氨酸和谷氨酰胺影响红鼓鱼的生长性能、免疫反应和肠道结构。
text_en: Dietary arginine and glutamine affect the growth performance, immune response, and intestinal structure of red drum.
intervention_record: 日粮精氨酸和谷氨酰胺

quote: Dietary arginine supplementation decreases plasma cortisol levels and modulates immune mechanisms in chronically stressed turbot (Scophthalmus maximus)
statement: 在慢性应激的大菱鲆中，补充日粮精氨酸可降低血浆皮质醇水平并调节免疫机制。
text_zh: 在慢性应激的大菱鲆中，补充日粮精氨酸可降低血浆皮质醇水平并调节免疫机制。
text_en: In turbot under chronic stress, dietary arginine supplementation reduces plasma cortisol levels and modulates immune mechanisms.

quote: Effect of dietary arginine on the immune response and gene expression in head kidney and spleen following infection of Jian carp with Aeromonas hydrophila.
statement: 日粮精氨酸影响建鲤感染嗜水气单胞菌后的免疫反应以及头肾和脾脏中的基因表达。
text_zh: 日粮精氨酸影响建鲤感染嗜水气单胞菌后的免疫反应以及头肾和脾脏中的基因表达。
text_en: Dietary arginine affects the immune response of Jian carp after infection with Aeromonas hydrophila and gene expression in the head kidney and spleen.

quote: Since antioxidant enzymes are essential for fish to avoid oxidative stress and scavenge superoxide anion and hydroxyl radicals [ 62 ], exogenous Arg supplementation may increase their antioxidant capacity.
statement: 由于抗氧化酶对于鱼类避免氧化应激和清除超氧阴离子及羟基自由基至关重要，外源精氨酸补充可能会增加其抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 由于抗氧化酶对于鱼类避免氧化应激和清除超氧阴离子及羟基自由基至关重要，外源精氨酸补充可能会增加其抗氧化能力。
text_en: Since antioxidant enzymes are crucial for fish to avoid oxidative stress and scavenge superoxide anions and hydroxyl radicals, exogenous arginine supplementation may increase their antioxidant capacity.

quote: Similar results were reported in hybrid grouper (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus ♀ × Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂) [ 63 ] and yellow catfish (Pelteobagrus fulvidraco) [ 64 ].
statement: 在杂交石斑鱼和黄颡鱼中报道了类似的结果。
text_zh: 在杂交石斑鱼和黄颡鱼中报道了类似的结果。
text_en: Similar results were reported in hybrid grouper and yellow catfish.

quote: This is a key reason why Arg supplementation is considered a strategy for improving immune responses [ 68 , 69 ].
statement: 这是精氨酸补充被视为改善免疫反应策略的一个关键原因。
text_zh: 这是精氨酸补充被视为改善免疫反应策略的一个关键原因。
text_en: This is a key reason why arginine supplementation is considered a strategy to improve immune response.

quote: For example, in turbot, Arg supplementation improved the immunosuppressive response because of high stocking density [ 70 ].
statement: 例如，在大菱鲆中，精氨酸补充改善了因高密度养殖引起的免疫抑制反应。
text_zh: 例如，在大菱鲆中，精氨酸补充改善了因高密度养殖引起的免疫抑制反应。
text_en: For example, in turbot, arginine supplementation improved the immunosuppressive response caused by high-density farming.

quote: In addition, studies on mirror carp (Cyprinus carpio) have shown that dietary Arg supplementation upregulates anti-inflammatory genes in the gut [ 62 ].
statement: 此外，关于镜鲤的研究表明，日粮精氨酸补充上调肠道中的抗炎基因。
text_zh: 此外，关于镜鲤的研究表明，日粮精氨酸补充上调肠道中的抗炎基因。
text_en: In addition, studies on mirror carp have shown that dietary arginine supplementation upregulates anti-inflammatory genes in the intestine.

quote: Our results showed il-1β expression in the liver was highest in the liver at 0.8% Arg level, in line with Chen et al. [ 71 ] and Hoseini et al. [ 72 ], who found upregulated il-1β and tnf-α levels in the heads and kidneys of carp after Arg supplementation.
statement: 本研究结果显示，在0.8%精氨酸水平下肝脏中il-1β表达最高，这与Chen等人及Hoseini等人在鲤鱼头部和肾脏中发现精氨酸补充后il-1β和tnf-α水平升高的结果一致。
text_zh: 本研究结果显示，在0.8%精氨酸水平下肝脏中il-1β表达最高，这与Chen等人及Hoseini等人在鲤鱼头部和肾脏中发现精氨酸补充后il-1β和tnf-α水平升高的结果一致。
text_en: The results of this study showed that il-1β expression in the liver was highest at the 0.8% arginine level, which is consistent with the findings by Chen et al. and Hoseini et al. who observed elevated levels of il-1β and tnf-α in the head kidney of carp after arginine supplementation.

quote:
The main aim of this work is to
investigate the effect of a marine probiotic bacteria, Bacillus cereus on the survival and growth
performance of gold fish Carassius auratus.
statement: 本研究的主要目的是调查海洋益生菌细菌蜡样芽孢杆菌对金鱼存活率和生长性能的影响。
text_zh: 本研究的主要目的是调查海洋益生菌细菌蜡样芽孢杆菌对金鱼存活率和生长性能的影响。
text_en: The main objective of this study was to investigate the effects of the marine probiotic bacterium Bacillus cereus on the survival rate and growth performance of goldfish.

quote:
During the last decades, antibiotics usage was a strategy for fish diseases management and also for
improvement of growth and efficiency of feed conversion an alternative approach to manage fish and
shrimp health that is fast gaining attention in the aquaculture industry is probiotics,”
statement: 抗生素的使用曾是鱼类疾病管理以及改善生长和饲料转化效率的策略，而益生菌作为管理鱼虾健康的替代方法正受到水产养殖业的关注。
text_zh: 抗生素的使用曾是鱼类疾病管理以及改善生长和饲料转化效率的策略，而益生菌作为管理鱼虾健康的替代方法正受到水产养殖业的关注。
text_en: The use of antibiotics was once a strategy for fish disease management and improving growth and feed conversion efficiency, while probiotics as an alternative method for managing the health of fish and shrimp are attracting attention in the aquaculture industry.

quote: Supplementation with probiotics gives resistance for disease, provides nutritional advantage and facilitates improvement of aquarium environment.
statement: 补充益生菌能赋予鱼类对疾病的抵抗力，提供营养优势并改善水族箱环境。
text_zh: 补充益生菌能赋予鱼类对疾病的抵抗力，提供营养优势并改善水族箱环境。
text_en: Supplementing probiotics can confer disease resistance to fish, provide nutritional advantages, and improve the aquarium environment.
outcome: 疾病抵抗力和水质环境

quote: Most ornamental fish require crude protein level in a range between 30–40%, carbohydrate provides instant energy. Carbohydrate is required between 30–50% lipids provide main energy sources level between 4–8%. Vitamin and minerals help to build up fish health and strengthen bones.
statement: 大多数观赏鱼需要30-40%的粗蛋白水平，碳水化合物提供即时能量且需求量在30-50%之间，脂质作为主要能量来源水平在4-8%之间，维生素和矿物质有助于建立鱼类健康和强化骨骼。
text_zh: 大多数观赏鱼需要30-40%的粗蛋白水平，碳水化合物提供即时能量且需求量在30-50%之间，脂质作为主要能量来源水平在4-8%之间，维生素和矿物质有助于建立鱼类健康和强化骨骼。
text_en: Most ornamental fish require a crude protein level of 30-40%, carbohydrates provide immediate energy and are required at levels between 30-50%, lipids serve as the main energy source at levels between 4-8%, and vitamins and minerals help establish fish health and strengthen bones.
intervention_record: 特定营养水平饲料配方

quote: Dietary arginine requirement of juvenile hybrid sturgeon (Acipenser schrenckii ♀ × Acipenser baerii ♂)
statement: 研究确定了杂交鲟幼鱼的日粮精氨酸需求。
text_zh: 研究确定了杂交鲟幼鱼的日粮精氨酸需求。
text_en: The study determined the dietary arginine requirement of juvenile hybrid sturgeon.

quote: Free-and peptide-based dietary arginine supplementation for the South American fish pacu (Piaractus mesopotamicus)
statement: 研究了游离和肽基日粮精氨酸补充对南美鱼pacu的影响。
text_zh: 研究了游离和肽基日粮精氨酸补充对南美鱼pacu的影响。
text_en: The effects of dietary arginine supplementation in free and peptide forms on South American fish pacu were studied.

quote: Effective supplementation of arginine in the diets of juvenile marine shrimp, Penaeus monodon.
statement: 在斑节对虾幼虾的日粮中有效补充精氨酸。
text_zh: 在斑节对虾幼虾的日粮中有效补充精氨酸。
text_en: Effective supplementation of arginine in the diet of Penaeus monodon postlarvae.

quote: Dietary supplementation of arginine and/or glutamine influences growth performance, immune responses and intestinal morphology of hybrid striped bass (Morone chrysops × Morone saxatilis)
statement: 日粮补充精氨酸和/或谷氨酰胺影响杂交条纹鲈的生长性能、免疫反应和肠道形态。
text_zh: 日粮补充精氨酸和/或谷氨酰胺影响杂交条纹鲈的生长性能、免疫反应和肠道形态。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with arginine and/or glutamine affects the growth performance, immune response, and intestinal morphology of hybrid striped bass.

population.species: 杂交条纹鲈 (Morone chrysops × Morone saxatilis)

intervention_record: 日粮精氨酸和谷氨酰胺
outcome: 生长性能、免疫反应、肠道形态

quote: Threonine modulates immune response, antioxidant status and gene expressions of antioxidant enzymes and antioxida
statement: 苏氨酸调节免疫反应、抗氧化状态以及抗氧化酶和抗氧化剂相关基因的表达。
text_zh: 苏氨酸调节免疫反应、抗氧化状态以及抗氧化酶和抗氧化剂相关基因的表达。
text_en: Threonine regulates immune responses, antioxidant status, and the expression of antioxidant enzymes and antioxidant-related genes.

quote: Under normal conditions, this effect on pro-inflammatory cytokines could be interpreted as enhancing the immune response, preparing fish to face pathogens.
statement: 在正常条件下，这种对促炎细胞因子的影响可以被解释为增强免疫反应，使鱼类准备好应对病原体。
text_zh: 在正常条件下，这种对促炎细胞因子的影响可以被解释为增强免疫反应，使鱼类准备好应对病原体。
text_en: Under normal conditions, this effect on pro-inflammatory cytokines can be interpreted as enhancing the immune response, preparing fish to respond to pathogens.

quote: Supporting this hypothesis, Chen et al. proposed that Arg enhances the immune response and increases resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila in Jian carp by upregulating the expression of pro-inflammatory genes [ 71 ].
statement: 支持这一假设的是，Chen等人提出精氨酸通过上调促炎基因的表达来增强建鲤的免疫反应并提高其对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_zh: 支持这一假设的是，Chen等人提出精氨酸通过上调促炎基因的表达来增强建鲤的免疫反应并提高其对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_en: Supporting this hypothesis, Chen et al. proposed that arginine enhances the immune response of crucian carp and improves its resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila by upregulating the expression of pro-inflammatory genes.

quote: That study’s findings show that 0.8% Arg supplementation significantly upregulated the relative expression of tgf-β , suggesting that appropriate Arg levels may attenuate tissue inflammation and reconcile body homeostasis by increasing the gene expression of anti-inflammatory factors such as tgf-β .
statement: 该研究的结果表明，0.8%的精氨酸补充显著上调了tgf-β的相对表达，提示适宜水平的精氨酸可能通过增加如tgf-β等抗炎因子的基因表达来减轻组织炎症并恢复体内稳态。
text_zh: 该研究的结果表明，0.8%的精氨酸补充显著上调了tgf-β的相对表达，提示适宜水平的精氨酸可能通过增加如tgf-β等抗炎因子的基因表达来减轻组织炎症并恢复体内稳态。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that 0.8% arginine supplementation significantly upregulated the relative expression of tgf-β, suggesting that an appropriate level of arginine may alleviate tissue inflammation and restore homeostasis by increasing the gene expression of anti-inflammatory factors such as tgf-β.

quote: Taken together with our results, this might indicate that Arg supplementation improves growth and immune responses.
statement: 结合我们的结果，这可能表明精氨酸补充改善了生长和免疫反应。
text_zh: 结合我们的结果，这可能表明精氨酸补充改善了生长和免疫反应。
text_en: Combined with our results, this may indicate that arginine supplementation improved growth and immune response.

quote: Although being considered with low toxicity for mammals, herbicides can pose negative effects on fish even at low concentrations
statement: 除草剂即使浓度很低，也可能对鱼类产生负面影响。
text_zh: 除草剂即使浓度很低，也可能对鱼类产生负面影响。
text_en: Herbicides may have negative effects on fish even at low concentrations.

quote: Arg is an essential amino acid for fish; therefore, any excess or shortage in the diet may reduce feed utilization and growth performance [ 44 ].
statement: 精氨酸是鱼类的必需氨基酸，因此饮食中过量或不足可能会降低饲料利用率和生长性能。
text_zh: 精氨酸是鱼类的必需氨基酸，因此饮食中过量或不足可能会降低饲料利用率和生长性能。
text_en: Arginine is an essential amino acid for fish, therefore excess or deficiency in the diet may reduce feed utilization and growth performance.

quote: In a previous study, the FBW of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) was improved when Arg feed levels increased from 1.72% to 3.09% [ 45 ].
statement: 在之前的研究中，当饲料中精氨酸水平从1.72%增加到3.09%时，虹鳟的终体重得到改善。
text_zh: 在之前的研究中，当饲料中精氨酸水平从1.72%增加到3.09%时，虹鳟的终体重得到改善。
text_en: In previous studies, when the arginine level in feed increased from 1.72% to 3.09%, the final body weight of rainbow trout improved.

quote: The WGR and feed efficiency of hybrid striped bass were also improved when feed was supplemented with 1.45% to 1.55% Arg levels [ 46 ].
statement: 当饲料补充1.45%至1.55%的精氨酸水平时，杂交条纹鲈的增重率和饲料效率也得到改善。
text_zh: 当饲料补充1.45%至1.55%的精氨酸水平时，杂交条纹鲈的增重率和饲料效率也得到改善。
text_en: When the diet is supplemented with arginine at levels of 1.45% to 1.55%, weight gain and feed efficiency in hybrid striped bass are also improved.

quote: In addition, studies have shown that Arg supplementation above the prescribed minimum requirement can improve feeding and growth in Atlantic salmon [ 16 ].
statement: 此外，研究表明，超过规定最低需求的精氨酸补充可以改善大西洋鲑的摄食和生长。
text_zh: 此外，研究表明，超过规定最低需求的精氨酸补充可以改善大西洋鲑的摄食和生长。
text_en: In addition, studies have shown that arginine supplementation exceeding the specified minimum requirements can improve feed intake and growth in Atlantic salmon.

quote: Two rectangular tank length 29.5 cm, height 13.5 cm and width 12.4 cm were taken and fitted by continuous aeration for maintain dissolved oxygen.
statement: 实验水箱配备了连续曝气以维持溶解氧。
text_zh: 实验水箱配备了连续曝气以维持溶解氧。
text_en: The experimental tanks were equipped with continuous aeration to maintain dissolved oxygen.

quote: The commercial food and formulated feed were fed to the fish based on 5% of biomass at the three intervals 7am, 1pm, and 6pm.
statement: 商业饲料和配方饲料按生物量的5%在三个时间段（上午7点、下午1点和下午6点）投喂给鱼。
text_zh: 商业饲料和配方饲料按生物量的5%在三个时间段（上午7点、下午1点和下午6点）投喂给鱼。
text_en: Commercial feed and formulated feed are fed to the fish at 5% of biomass at three time points (7 a.m., 1 p.m., and 6 p.m.).

quote: 75% of water was changed every two days of experimental period.
statement: 在实验期间，每两天更换75%的水。
text_zh: 在实验期间，每两天更换75%的水。
text_en: During the experiment, 75% of the water was changed every two days.

quote: For Morphometric measurement fish were sampled in separate container having water. Fish was taken outside water to weigh and released back to respective aquaria
statement: 为了进行形态测量，鱼被采样到装有水的单独容器中，取出水面称重后放回各自的水族箱。
text_zh: 为了进行形态测量，鱼被采样到装有水的单独容器中，取出水面称重后放回各自的水族箱。
text_en: For morphometric measurements, fish were sampled into separate containers filled with water, weighed out of the water, and then returned to their respective aquariums.

quote: Probiotics bacteria proposed as an alternative to antibiotics.
statement: 益生菌细菌被提议作为抗生素的替代品。
text_zh: 益生菌细菌被提议作为抗生素的替代品。
text_en: Probiotic bacteria are proposed as alternatives to antibiotics.

quote: For experiments Bacillus Sp. is incorporated with traditionally formulated ornamental fish feed are able to significantly reduce the accumulation of organic waste and also increase the feed digestibility, prevent microbial disease, avoid water pollution and also probiotics act as nutrient supplements in artificial feed of gold fish.
statement: 在实验中，将芽孢杆菌属（Bacillus Sp.）掺入传统配方的观赏鱼饲料中，能够显著减少有机废物的积累，提高饲料消化率，预防微生物疾病，避免水污染，并且益生菌在金鱼的配合饲料中充当营养补充剂。
text_zh: 在实验中，将芽孢杆菌属（Bacillus Sp.）掺入传统配方的观赏鱼饲料中，能够显著减少有机废物的积累，提高饲料消化率，预防微生物疾病，避免水污染，并且益生菌在金鱼的配合饲料中充当营养补充剂。
text_en: In the experiment, incorporating Bacillus Sp. into traditional ornamental fish feed significantly reduced organic waste accumulation, improved feed digestibility, prevented microbial diseases, avoided water pollution, and probiotics acted as nutritional supplements in goldfish compound feed.

quote: The increased intensity of Aquaculture has led to a high number of disease outbreaks with an increasing range of pathogens as a result in serious economic losses.
statement: 水产养殖强度的增加导致了大量的疾病爆发和病原体范围的扩大，从而造成严重的经济损失。
text_zh: 水产养殖强度的增加导致了大量的疾病爆发和病原体范围的扩大，从而造成严重的经济损失。
text_en: Increased intensity of aquaculture has led to a large number of disease outbreaks and an expanded range of pathogens, resulting in severe economic losses.

quote: The blood samples were acquired from the caudal vein using the heparinized plastic syringe for each experimental crucian carp, and thereafter, muscle with skin, gill filament, liver, and kidney were excised from each crucian carp.
statement: 使用肝素化塑料注射器从每条实验鲫鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本，随后从每条鲫鱼中切除带皮肌肉、鳃丝、肝脏和肾脏。
text_zh: 使用肝素化塑料注射器从每条实验鲫鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本，随后从每条鲫鱼中切除带皮肌肉、鳃丝、肝脏和肾脏。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the tail vein of each experimental crucian carp using a heparinized plastic syringe, followed by excision of skin-on muscle, gill filaments, liver, and kidney from each crucian carp.

quote: During the whole experimental period about 40 days water temperature dissolved oxygen, pH and total ammonia are in acceptable level and the experimental diets had no adverse effects on the surrounding water quality of experimental fish.
statement: 在整个约40天的实验期间，水温、溶解氧、pH值和总氨处于可接受水平，且实验日粮对实验鱼周围的水质没有不利影响。
text_zh: 在整个约40天的实验期间，水温、溶解氧、pH值和总氨处于可接受水平，且实验日粮对实验鱼周围的水质没有不利影响。
text_en: During the entire experimental period of about 40 days, water temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, and total ammonia were at acceptable levels, and the experimental diet had no adverse effect on the water quality around the experimental fish.

quote:
Numerous studies have shown that, the application of probiotics can improve weight
gain, feed conversion ratio, specific growth rate [1]; [5]; [9].
statement: Previous studies indicate that applying probiotics improves weight gain, feed conversion ratio, and specific growth rate.
text_en: Previous studies indicate that applying probiotics improves weight gain, feed conversion ratio, and specific growth rate.

population.species: farmed fish and other aquatic species

quote:
It is known from this paper that Bacillus cereus
act as a significant feed- additive enhancing the growth and survival for gold fish which is also evident
from some other articles [11]; [3].
statement: Bacillus cereus acts as a feed additive that enhances growth and survival in goldfish.
text_en: Bacillus cereus acts as a feed additive that enhances growth and survival in goldfish.

quote:
Based on the obtained result, it is known that bacillus cereus played an important role in enhancing the
survival, weight gain, FCR, and SGR of reared Carassius auratus.
statement: Bacillus cereus enhanced survival, weight gain, feed conversion ratio, and specific growth rate in reared Carassius auratus.
text_en: Bacillus cereus enhanced survival, weight gain, feed conversion ratio, and specific growth rate in reared Carassius auratus.

quote:
Similarly ,Bacillus cereus reduced fish
mortality.
statement: Bacillus cereus reduced fish mortality.
text_en: Bacillus cereus reduced fish mortality.

quote: The crucian carps were exposed to pendimethalin at 13.8 μ g/L and 41.4 μ g/L in a semistatic system.
statement: 鲫鱼在静态系统中暴露于13.8 μg/L和41.4 μg/L的二甲戊灵。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在静态系统中暴露于13.8 μg/L和41.4 μg/L的二甲戊灵。
text_en: Crucian carp were exposed to pendimethalin at 13.8 μg/L and 41.4 μg/L in a static system.

quote: the fish fed with probiotic feed showed significantly higher growth rate compared to control feed.
statement: 饲喂益生菌饲料的鱼与对照饲料相比表现出显著更高的生长率。
text_zh: 饲喂益生菌饲料的鱼与对照饲料相比表现出显著更高的生长率。
text_en: Fish fed probiotic feed showed significantly higher growth rates compared to those fed control feed.

quote: The growth performance including weight gain (WG), feed conversion ratio (FCR), specific growth rate (SGR) had higher significant difference between diets contained formulated probiotic feed to the control group.
statement: 包括增重、饲料转化率和特定生长率在内的生长性能在含配方益生菌饲料的日粮与对照组之间存在显著差异。
text_zh: 包括增重、饲料转化率和特定生长率在内的生长性能在含配方益生菌饲料的日粮与对照组之间存在显著差异。
text_en: Growth performance, including weight gain, feed conversion ratio and specific growth rate, showed significant differences between diets containing probiotic-supplemented feed and the control group.

quote: The crucian carps were fed with feedstuff at 1.5 percent of body weight once a day.
statement: 鲫鱼每天按体重的1.5%投喂饲料一次。
text_zh: 鲫鱼每天按体重的1.5%投喂饲料一次。
text_en: Crucian carp are fed once a day at 1.5% of their body weight.

quote: To maintain the hygienic environment, fecal matter and other waste materials were removed in time during the exposure experiment.
statement: 为了维持卫生环境，在暴露实验期间及时清除了粪便和其他废物。
text_zh: 为了维持卫生环境，在暴露实验期间及时清除了粪便和其他废物。
text_en: To maintain a hygienic environment, feces and other waste were promptly removed during the exposure experiment.

quote: ndimethalin has been detected at high concentrations in rivers in Brittany, France (840 ng/L), and in surface waters in several European countries, which is known to affect various biotic components of freshwater ecosystems, such as phytoplankton, zooplankton, and aquatic fauna [ 9 ].
statement: Pendimethalin contamination in water bodies is known to affect various biotic components of freshwater ecosystems, including aquatic fauna.
text_en: Pendimethalin contamination in water bodies is known to affect various biotic components of freshwater ecosystems, including aquatic fauna.

quote: Pendimethalin applied in agricultural fields entered into nearby aquatic systems, resulted in detrimental effects on nontarget aquatic organisms including fishes [ 13 ].
statement: Pendimethalin entering aquatic systems results in detrimental effects on non-target aquatic organisms, including fish.
text_en: Pendimethalin entering aquatic systems results in detrimental effects on non-target aquatic organisms, including fish.

quote: It is considered a moderately to extremely toxic compound for fish and aquatic organism, which can generate long-lasting metabolites and induce deleterious effects on fishes [ 15 ].
statement: Pendimethalin is considered moderately to extremely toxic for fish and aquatic organisms, inducing deleterious effects through long-lasting metabolites.
text_en: Pendimethalin is considered moderately to extremely toxic for fish and aquatic organisms, inducing deleterious effects through long-lasting metabolites.

quote: The toxicity of pendimethalin varies from species to species and its effects on various aspects of fishes have been reported from time to time, covering alterations of biochemical parameters in Oreochromis niloticus [ 16 ], biochemical and histological perturbations in liver, kidney, and gill of freshwater fish [ 15 ], histological changes in the gill epithelium and altered general branchial functions in Tilapia nilotica [ 17 ], induction of oxidative stress in rainbow trout and Channa punctatus [ 7 , 18 ],
statement: Pendimethalin causes species-specific toxic effects in fish, including biochemical parameter alterations, histological perturbations in organs, gill function changes, and oxidative stress.
text_en: Pendimethalin causes species-specific toxic effects in fish, including biochemical parameter alterations, histological perturbations in organs, gill function changes, and oxidative stress.

population.species: Oreochromis niloticus; freshwater fish; Tilapia nilotica; rainbow trout; Channa punctatus

quote: The pendimethalin residues in various fish tissues increased initially and then decreased, and the residue amount of pendimethalin varied from tissue to tissue of crucian carp.
statement: 各种鱼组织中的二甲戊灵残留量先增加后减少，且不同组织间的残留量存在差异。
text_zh: 各种鱼组织中的二甲戊灵残留量先增加后减少，且不同组织间的残留量存在差异。
text_en: Pendimethalin residues in various fish tissues first increased and then decreased, and residue levels differed among tissues.

quote: Particularly, the pendimethalin accumulation in most fish tissues made significant decreases at two-time points.
statement: 特别是在两个时间点，大多数鱼组织中的二甲戊灵积累显著下降。
text_zh: 特别是在两个时间点，大多数鱼组织中的二甲戊灵积累显著下降。
text_en: Especially at two time points, pendimethalin accumulation in most fish tissues decreased significantly.

quote: Pendimethalin was initially absorbed and enriched by fish body, and then partial pendimethalin was discharged into the outside environment through the metabolism function of crucian carp.
statement: 二甲戊灵最初被鱼体吸收并富集，随后部分二甲戊灵通过鲫鱼的代谢功能排出到外部环境中。
text_zh: 二甲戊灵最初被鱼体吸收并富集，随后部分二甲戊灵通过鲫鱼的代谢功能排出到外部环境中。
text_en: Pendimethalin was initially absorbed and bioaccumulated by the fish, after which some pendimethalin was excreted into the external environment through the metabolic functions of crucian carp.

quote: effect on the susceptibility of Oncorhynchus mykiss L. to viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus (VHSV)
statement: Pendimethalin affects the susceptibility of Oncorhynchus mykiss L. to viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus (VHSV).
text_en: Pendimethalin affects the susceptibility of Oncorhynchus mykiss L. to viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus (VHSV).

quote: neurotoxicological assessment of pendimethalin in Channa punctata Bloch
statement: Neurotoxicological assessments have been conducted regarding the effect of pendimethalin on Channa punctata Bloch.
text_en: Neurotoxicological assessments have been conducted regarding the effect of pendimethalin on Channa punctata Bloch.

quote: fish must activate several responses to such environmental stressors and give rise to alter the fish metabolism including growth, reproduction, survival skills, and immunity
statement: To resist toxic impacts from environmental stressors like pesticides, fish activate responses that alter their metabolism, affecting growth, reproduction, survival skills, and immunity.
text_en: To resist toxic impacts from environmental stressors like pesticides, fish activate responses that alter their metabolism, affecting growth, reproduction, survival skills, and immunity.

quote: Sarımsaklı istasyonunda ise özellikle çözünmüş oksijen değerinin yaz ve sonbahar aylarında diğer istasyonlara göre daha düşük olduğu gözlenmiştir.

statement: 在两种异育银鲫品系中，高碳水低脂（HCLL）饲料组的鱼肝脏粗脂肪和甘油三酯水平最高。

text_en: In two allogynogenetic gibel carp strains, the high-carbohydrate low-fat (HCLL) diet group had the highest liver crude fat and triglyceride levels.

quote: To elucidate the effects of different farming modes on the digestive capacity of C. auratus , the activities of three major digestive enzymes, respectively amylase, lipase, and trypsin, were assayed.
statement: 为了阐明不同养殖模式对鲫鱼消化能力的影响，测定了淀粉酶、脂肪酶和胰蛋白酶三种主要消化酶的活性。
text_zh: 为了阐明不同养殖模式对鲫鱼消化能力的影响，测定了淀粉酶、脂肪酶和胰蛋白酶三种主要消化酶的活性。
text_en: To clarify the effects of different farming modes on the digestive capacity of crucian carp, the activities of three major digestive enzymes—amylase, lipase, and trypsin—were measured.

quote: As the results were shown in Table 1 , the activities of amylase (PA: 18.31 ± 1.82 U/g; PO: 17.71 ± 1.23 U/g) and trypsin (PA: 9.79 ± 0.73 IU/g; PO: 9.20 ± 0.58 IU/g) were significantly higher in PA compared with PO
statement: 结果显示，稻田组（PA）的淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶活性显著高于池塘组（PO）。
text_zh: 结果显示，稻田组（PA）的淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶活性显著高于池塘组（PO）。
text_en: The results showed that amylase and trypsin activities in the rice paddy group (PA) were significantly higher than those in the pond group (PO).

population.system: 稻田养殖 vs 池塘养殖

quote: In C. auratus liver, the enzymatic activity of CAT was significantly higher in PA (2.45 ± 0.16 U/mg) compared with PO (2.27 ± 0.25 U/mg)
statement: 在鲫鱼肝脏中，稻田组（PA）的过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性显著高于池塘组（PO）。
text_zh: 在鲫鱼肝脏中，稻田组（PA）的过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性显著高于池塘组（PO）。
text_en: In the liver of crucian carp, catalase (CAT) activity in the rice paddy group (PA) was significantly higher than in the pond group (PO).

population.system: 稻田养殖 vs 池塘养殖

quote: Intestinal tract samples were used to assay amylase, lipase, and trypsin activities.
statement: 肠道样本用于测定淀粉酶、脂肪酶和胰蛋白酶活性。
text_zh: 肠道样本用于测定淀粉酶、脂肪酶和胰蛋白酶活性。
text_en: Intestinal samples were used to determine amylase, lipase, and trypsin activities.

quote: Liver samples were used to assay total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), malondialdehyde (MDA) content and superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), catalase (CAT), Na+K+–ATPase (NKA), pyruvate kinase (PK), glucokinase (GK), glucose-6-phosphatase (G6pase), and 6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PDH) activities.
statement: 肝脏样本用于测定总抗氧化能力(T-AOC)、丙二醛(MDA)含量以及超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPx)、过氧化氢酶(CAT)、Na+K+-ATP酶(NKA)、丙酮酸激酶(PK)、葡萄糖激酶(GK)、葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶(G6pase)和6-磷酸葡萄糖脱氢酶(G6PDH)的活性。
text_zh: 肝脏样本用于测定总抗氧化能力(T-AOC)、丙二醛(MDA)含量以及超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPx)、过氧化氢酶(CAT)、Na+K+-ATP酶(NKA)、丙酮酸激酶(PK)、葡萄糖激酶(GK)、葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶(G6pase)和6-磷酸葡萄糖脱氢酶(G6PDH)的活性。
text_en: Liver samples were used to determine total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), malondialdehyde (MDA) content, and the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), catalase (CAT), Na+K+-ATPase (NKA), pyruvate kinase (PK), glucokinase (GK), glucose-6-phosphatase (G6pase), and glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PDH).

quote: In addition, lipogenesis potential was increased in the fish fed the HCLL diet, as indicated by the increased abundance of srebp1-c and acly transcripts in the liver and the increased abundance of srebp1-c and acc in the muscle.
statement: 饲喂高碳水低脂饲料的鱼脂肪生成潜力增加，表现为肝脏srebp1-c和acly转录本丰度以及肌肉srebp1-c和acc丰度增加。
text_zh: 饲喂高碳水低脂饲料的鱼脂肪生成潜力增加，表现为肝脏srebp1-c和acly转录本丰度以及肌肉srebp1-c和acc丰度增加。
text_en: Fish fed a high-carbohydrate low-fat diet showed increased lipogenic potential, as indicated by increased abundance of liver srebp1-c and acly transcripts and muscle srebp1-c and acc.

quote: However, traditional pond aquaculture has several issues, including poor habitat, land resource occupation, and environmental pollution, and it has become a consensus to explore a new aquaculture model
statement: 传统池塘养殖存在栖息地质量差、占用土地资源和环境污染等问题，因此探索新的养殖模式已成为共识。
text_zh: 传统池塘养殖存在栖息地质量差、占用土地资源和环境污染等问题，因此探索新的养殖模式已成为共识。
text_en: Traditional pond aquaculture has problems such as poor habitat quality, land resource occupation, and environmental pollution; therefore, exploring new farming models has become a consensus.
outcome: 栖息地质量与环境状况

quote: Rice-fish farming is thought to improve the living environment for fish; for example, rice relieves high temperatures in water during the summer and reduces ammonia-nitrogen levels; thus, fish in rice paddies are more energetic and have more swimming and feeding behaviors
statement: 稻鱼共生系统被认为能改善鱼类的生活环境，例如水稻在夏季缓解水温过高并降低氨氮水平，从而使稻田中的鱼精力更充沛，游泳和摄食行为更多。
text_zh: 稻鱼共生系统被认为能改善鱼类的生活环境，例如水稻在夏季缓解水温过高并降低氨氮水平，从而使稻田中的鱼精力更充沛，游泳和摄食行为更多。
text_en: The rice-fish co-culture system is considered to improve the living environment of fish, for example, rice alleviates high water temperatures and reduces ammonia nitrogen levels in summer, thereby making the fish in paddy fields more energetic and increasing their swimming and feeding behaviors.

quote: Similarly, many studies have explored the enhancement of aquatic product quality by the rice-fish farming system in the pathways of gut homeostasis, immunity, and stress.
statement: 许多研究探讨了稻鱼共生系统通过肠道稳态、免疫和应激途径提升水产品质量的效果。
text_zh: 许多研究探讨了稻鱼共生系统通过肠道稳态、免疫和应激途径提升水产品质量的效果。
text_en: Many studies have explored the effects of rice-fish co-culture systems on improving aquatic product quality through intestinal homeostasis, immunity, and stress pathways.

quote: In blunt snout bream (Megalobrama amblycephala), the activity levels of growth and digestive enzymes increased when dietary lipid content increased from 40 to 70 g kg −1 , reducing the proportion of dietary protein catabolized for energy (13).
statement: 在团头鲂中，当日粮脂质含量从40增加到70 g/kg时，生长和消化酶的活性水平增加，减少了用于能量的日粮蛋白质分解比例。
text_zh: 在团头鲂中，当日粮脂质含量从40增加到70 g/kg时，生长和消化酶的活性水平增加，减少了用于能量的日粮蛋白质分解比例。
text_en: In blunt snout bream, when the dietary lipid content increased from 40 to 70 g/kg, growth and digestive enzyme activity levels increased, reducing the proportion of dietary protein catabolized for energy.

quote: Thus, increasing lipid contents may provide adequate energy for the F strain, reducing protein catabolism and contributing to the higher PRE observed in the F strain fed the LCHL diet.
statement: 因此，增加脂质含量可能为F品系提供充足的能量，减少蛋白质分解代谢，并有助于观察到的饲喂低碳水高脂日粮的F品系具有更高的蛋白质效率值。
text_zh: 因此，增加脂质含量可能为F品系提供充足的能量，减少蛋白质分解代谢，并有助于观察到的饲喂低碳水高脂日粮的F品系具有更高的蛋白质效率值。
text_en: Therefore, increasing lipid content may provide sufficient energy for the F strain, reduce protein catabolism, and contribute to the higher protein efficiency values observed in the F strain fed a low-carbohydrate, high-lipid diet.
outcome: 蛋白质代谢与能量供应

quote: In addition, the Fischer ratio was significantly higher in PA (2.09 ± 0.10) compared with PO (1.58 ± 0.02)
statement: 此外，稻田组（PA）的Fischer比值显著高于池塘组（PO）。
text_zh: 此外，稻田组（PA）的Fischer比值显著高于池塘组（PO）。
text_en: In addition, the Fischer ratio of the rice paddy group (PA) was significantly higher than that of the pond group (PO).

statement: 表3数据显示，稻田养殖组（PA）的丙酮酸激酶（PK）活性显著低于池塘养殖组（PO）。
text_zh: 表3数据显示，稻田养殖组（PA）的丙酮酸激酶（PK）活性显著低于池塘养殖组（PO）。
text_en: Data in Table 3 show that pyruvate kinase (PK) activity in the rice-field aquaculture group (PA) was significantly lower than that in the pond aquaculture group (PO).

population.system: 稻田养殖 vs 池塘养殖

quote: Additionally, the hepatic catalase (CAT) activity in fish from paddy (2.45 ± 0.16 U/mg) exceeded that of their pond counterparts (2.27 ± 0.25 U/mg).
statement: 此外，稻田鱼类的肝脏过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性（2.45 ± 0.16 U/mg）超过了池塘鱼类（2.27 ± 0.25 U/mg）。
text_zh: 此外，稻田鱼类的肝脏过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性（2.45 ± 0.16 U/mg）超过了池塘鱼类（2.27 ± 0.25 U/mg）。
text_en: In addition, the liver catalase (CAT) activity of rice-field fish (2.45 ± 0.16 U/mg) exceeded that of pond fish (2.27 ± 0.25 U/mg).

quote: Fischer ratio 2.09 ± 0.10 b 1.58 ± 0.02 a
statement: 稻田组的Fischer比值（2.09 ± 0.10）显著高于池塘组（1.58 ± 0.02）。
text_zh: 稻田组的Fischer比值（2.09 ± 0.10）显著高于池塘组（1.58 ± 0.02）。
text_en: The Fischer ratio of the rice paddy group (2.09 ± 0.10) was significantly higher than that of the pond group (1.58 ± 0.02).

quote: Similarly, another study on crayfish demonstrated that rice-fish symbiosis led to changes in their intestinal microbiota, stimulating the digestive function of the hepatopancreas [ 14 ].
statement: 另一项关于小龙虾的研究表明，稻渔共生导致其肠道微生物群发生变化，刺激了肝胰腺的消化功能。
text_zh: 另一项关于小龙虾的研究表明，稻渔共生导致其肠道微生物群发生变化，刺激了肝胰腺的消化功能。
text_en: Another study on crayfish showed that rice-fish co-culture led to changes in their gut microbiota and stimulated the digestive function of the hepatopancreas.

quote: In our results, the activities of amylase and trypsin were significantly higher in the PA group compared to the PO group.
statement: 在本研究结果中，与PO组相比，PA组的淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶活性显著较高。
text_zh: 在本研究结果中，与PO组相比，PA组的淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶活性显著较高。
text_en: In the results of this study, amylase and trypsin activities were significantly higher in the PA group compared to the PO group.

quote: Meanwhile, natural food intake, including plant and animal feeds, is considered more suitable for gut health in omnivorous fish [ 26 ].
statement: 同时，包括植物性和动物性饲料在内的天然食物摄入被认为更适合杂食性鱼类的肠道健康。
text_zh: 同时，包括植物性和动物性饲料在内的天然食物摄入被认为更适合杂食性鱼类的肠道健康。
text_en: At the same time, natural food intake, including plant-based and animal-based feed, is considered more suitable for the gut health of omnivorous fish.

quote: Although the exact pathway is not yet clear, the higher activities of amylase and trypsin in the intestines of PA group C. auratus may be associated with their increased foraging on plants (e.g., weeds and phytoplankton) and insects due to the abundant food present in farmland environments [ 13 , 27 ].
statement: 虽然确切途径尚不清楚，但PA组鲫鱼肠道中较高的淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶活性可能与它们在农田环境中因食物丰富而增加对植物（如杂草和浮游植物）和昆虫的觅食有关。
text_zh: 虽然确切途径尚不清楚，但PA组鲫鱼肠道中较高的淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶活性可能与它们在农田环境中因食物丰富而增加对植物（如杂草和浮游植物）和昆虫的觅食有关。
text_en: Although the exact pathway is unclear, the higher amylase and trypsin activities in the intestines of crucian carp in the PA group may be related to their increased foraging on plants (such as weeds and phytoplankton) and insects due to abundant food in the paddy field environment.

quote: For instance, Wang et al. [ 39 ] reported that changes in diet composition affected total antioxidant capacity and superoxide dismutase activity in Chinese mitten crab.
statement: 例如，Wang等人报道饮食组成的变化影响了中华绒螯蟹的总抗氧化能力和超氧化物歧化酶活性。
text_zh: 例如，Wang等人报道饮食组成的变化影响了中华绒螯蟹的总抗氧化能力和超氧化物歧化酶活性。
text_en: For example, Wang et al. reported that changes in diet composition affected the total antioxidant capacity and superoxide dismutase activity of Chinese mitten crabs.

quote: Qiu et al. [ 40 ] investigated the effects of water factors on the antioxidant system of largemouth bass (micropterus salmoides) and showed that MDA content and lysozyme activity were significantly and positively correlated with nitrite nitrogen content.
statement: Qiu等人研究了水环境因子对大口黑鲷抗氧化系统的影响，并显示MDA含量和溶菌酶活性与亚硝酸盐氮含量呈显著正相关。
text_zh: Qiu等人研究了水环境因子对大口黑鲷抗氧化系统的影响，并显示MDA含量和溶菌酶活性与亚硝酸盐氮含量呈显著正相关。
text_en: Qiu et al. studied the effects of water environmental factors on the antioxidant system of largemouth bass, and showed that MDA content and lysozyme activity were significantly positively correlated with nitrite nitrogen content.
outcome: 氧化应激指标与免疫活性

quote: The presence of these organisms provides crucian carp with hiding places, a more diverse range of food sources, and a suitable living environment that is more in line with their natural habits, which is beneficial for ensuring animal welfare [ 27 ].
statement: 这些生物的存在为鲫鱼提供了隐蔽场所、更多样化的食物来源以及更符合其自然习性的适宜生活环境，这有利于确保动物福利。
text_zh: 这些生物的存在为鲫鱼提供了隐蔽场所、更多样化的食物来源以及更符合其自然习性的适宜生活环境，这有利于确保动物福利。
text_en: The presence of these organisms provides crucian carp with hiding places, a more diverse food source, and a suitable living environment that better matches their natural habits, which helps ensure animal welfare.
outcome: 动物福利（隐蔽处、食物多样性、自然习性）

quote: This is advantageous for the health of the crucian carp and is reflected in their better antioxidant enzyme activity.
statement: 这对鲫鱼的健康有利，并反映在其更好的抗氧化酶活性上。
text_zh: 这对鲫鱼的健康有利，并反映在其更好的抗氧化酶活性上。
text_en: This is beneficial to the health of crucian carp and is reflected in their better antioxidant enzyme activity.
outcome: 健康状态与抗氧化酶活性

quote: The mechanisms by which rice-fish farming affects the antioxidant capacity of fish are still unclear, and further research will help optimize the aquaculture strategies for rice-fish farming systems.
statement: 稻渔共作影响鱼类抗氧化能力的机制尚不清楚，进一步的研究将有助于优化稻渔共作系统的水产养殖策略。
text_zh: 稻渔共作影响鱼类抗氧化能力的机制尚不清楚，进一步的研究将有助于优化稻渔共作系统的水产养殖策略。
text_en: The mechanism by which rice-fish co-culture affects the antioxidant capacity of fish is not yet clear; further research will help optimize aquaculture strategies for rice-fish co-culture systems.

quote: The results indicated that rice-fish farming influenced the digestive enzyme activity, antioxidant defense system enzyme activity, liver carbohydrate metabolism, and muscle nutritional components of C. auratus .
statement: 稻鱼共作养殖影响了鲤鱼的消化酶活性、抗氧化防御系统酶活性、肝脏碳水化合物代谢和肌肉营养成分。
text_zh: 稻鱼共作养殖影响了鲤鱼的消化酶活性、抗氧化防御系统酶活性、肝脏碳水化合物代谢和肌肉营养成分。
text_en: Rice-fish co-culture farming affected the digestive enzyme activity, antioxidant defense system enzyme activity, liver carbohydrate metabolism, and muscle nutritional composition of common carp.

population.system: 稻鱼共作 vs 池塘养殖

quote: These changes are associated with the rich biodiversity in the rice paddies, which provide a living environment and natural food that are more in line with the natural habits and diet of the C. auratus .
statement: 这些变化与稻田丰富的生物多样性有关，后者提供了更符合鲤鱼自然习性和饮食的生活环境和天然食物。
text_zh: 这些变化与稻田丰富的生物多样性有关，后者提供了更符合鲤鱼自然习性和饮食的生活环境和天然食物。
text_en: These changes are related to the rich biodiversity of rice paddies, which provide a living environment and natural food that better suit the natural habits and diet of carp.
intervention_record: 高生物多样性自然环境
outcome: 生活环境与摄食习性匹配度

quote: The level of digestive enzyme activity directly affects the ability of fish to digest food, and improving the activity of digestive enzymes can effectively improve the utilization of nutrients by fish, which in turn improves their growth performance [ 24 ].
statement: 消化酶活性水平直接影响鱼类消化食物的能力，提高消化酶活性可以有效改善鱼类对营养物质的利用，进而提高其生长性能。
text_zh: 消化酶活性水平直接影响鱼类消化食物的能力，提高消化酶活性可以有效改善鱼类对营养物质的利用，进而提高其生长性能。
text_en: Digestive enzyme activity levels directly affect the ability of fish to digest food; increasing digestive enzyme activity can effectively improve the utilization of nutrients by fish, thereby enhancing their growth performance.

quote: Tilapia living in rice paddies have a higher intestinal microbiota diversity, which improves their digestion and absorption, leading to higher growth rates [ 15 ].
statement: 生活在稻田中的罗非鱼具有更高的肠道微生物多样性，这改善了它们的消化吸收，从而带来更高的生长率。
text_zh: 生活在稻田中的罗非鱼具有更高的肠道微生物多样性，这改善了它们的消化吸收，从而带来更高的生长率。
text_en: Tilapia living in rice paddies have higher intestinal microbial diversity, which improves their digestion and absorption, thereby leading to higher growth rates.

quote: Crayfish have a more stable intestinal environment in rice paddies, promoting better nutrient absorption [ 25 ].
statement: 小龙虾在稻田中具有更稳定的肠道环境，促进了更好的营养吸收。
text_zh: 小龙虾在稻田中具有更稳定的肠道环境，促进了更好的营养吸收。
text_en: Crayfish in rice paddies have a more stable gut environment, which promotes better nutrient absorption.

quote: This suggests that C. auratus in the PA group is in good health.
statement: 这表明PA组的鲫鱼健康状况良好。
text_zh: 这表明PA组的鲫鱼健康状况良好。
text_en: This indicates that the crucian carp in the PA group were in good health.

quote: Since food sources are more abundant in paddy, changes in PK activity may be related to the type of carbohydrates ingested, suggesting differences in dietary composition between paddy and pond.
statement: 由于稻田食物来源更丰富，PK活性的变化可能与摄入的碳水化合物类型有关，表明稻田和池塘之间的膳食组成存在差异。
text_zh: 由于稻田食物来源更丰富，PK活性的变化可能与摄入的碳水化合物类型有关，表明稻田和池塘之间的膳食组成存在差异。
text_en: Because food sources are more abundant in rice paddies, changes in PK activity may be related to the type of ingested carbohydrates, indicating differences in dietary composition between rice paddies and ponds.

quote: Rice-fish farming ecosystems have richer biodiversity than traditional aquaculture ponds [ 67 ], and rich groups of microbes could serve as additional food for C. auratus .
statement: 稻鱼共作生态系统比传统养殖池塘具有更丰富的生物多样性，且丰富的微生物群可作为鲫鱼的额外食物。
text_zh: 稻鱼共作生态系统比传统养殖池塘具有更丰富的生物多样性，且丰富的微生物群可作为鲫鱼的额外食物。
text_en: The rice-fish co-culture ecosystem has richer biodiversity than traditional aquaculture ponds, and the abundant microbial community can serve as additional food for crucian carp.

population.system: 稻鱼共作 vs 传统池塘养殖

quote: Inayat suggested that it was related to the feeding of fish in different environments.
statement: Inayat认为这种差异与鱼类在不同环境中的摄食有关。
text_zh: Inayat认为这种差异与鱼类在不同环境中的摄食有关。
text_en: Inayat believes that this difference is related to fish feeding in different environments.

quote: one of the reasons might be the rich food sources in paddy that provide a diet more in line with the natural feeding habits of C. auratus .
statement: 原因之一可能是稻田中丰富的食物来源提供了更符合C. auratus自然摄食习惯的饮食。

quote: Mean±standard deviation of growth in weight (g) of juvenile C. auratus fed with natural and artificial food cultivated in two different culture systems.

statement: 在本研究中，我们发现PA组肝脏过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性显著增加。

text_en: In this study, we found that catalase (CAT) activity in the liver of the PA group increased significantly.

quote: The level of T-AOC and activities of SOD and GPx showed an increasing trend in the PA group, although there was no significant difference.

text_en: The total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) levels and SOD and GPx activities in the PA group showed an upward trend, but the differences were not significant.
outcome: 全身及肝脏抗氧化指标

quote: Similar to our results, Chinese mitten crabs (Eriocheir sinensis) living in lakes with greater species diversity showed higher CAT activity and lower MDA levels [ 38 ].
statement: 与我们的结果类似，生活在物种多样性较高的湖泊中的中华绒螯蟹表现出更高的CAT活性和更低的MDA水平。
text_zh: 与我们的结果类似，生活在物种多样性较高的湖泊中的中华绒螯蟹表现出更高的CAT活性和更低的MDA水平。
text_en: Similar to our results, Chinese mitten crabs living in lakes with higher species diversity exhibited higher CAT activity and lower MDA levels.
intervention_record: 高生物多样性自然环境
outcome: 抗氧化状态与氧化应激
