quote: In the first and fourth treatment, animals were fed with brine shrimp biomass (50% CP), while in the second and third treatments a commercial flake ration (42% CP) was used.
statement: Nos tratamentos primeiro e quarto, os animais foram alimentados com biomassa de Artemia salina (50% PB), enquanto nos tratamentos segundo e terceiro foi utilizada uma ração comercial em flocos (42% PB).
text_en: Nos tratamentos primeiro e quarto, os animais foram alimentados com biomassa de Artemia salina (50% PB), enquanto nos tratamentos segundo e terceiro foi utilizada uma ração comercial em flocos (42% PB).

quote: Fish at the top of the food chain in aquatic ecosystems are particularly susceptible to PFOS accumulation, which can result in substantial alterations in liver-specific protein profiles, increased immune cell populations, and structural damage, eventually triggering fibrosis and compromising immune functions [ 19 ].
statement: 处于食物链顶端的鱼类特别容易受到PFOS积累的影响，这可能导致肝脏特异性蛋白谱的改变、免疫细胞群增加和结构损伤，最终引发纤维化并损害免疫功能。
text_zh: 处于食物链顶端的鱼类特别容易受到PFOS积累的影响，这可能导致肝脏特异性蛋白谱的改变、免疫细胞群增加和结构损伤，最终引发纤维化并损害免疫功能。
text_en: Fish at the top of the food chain are particularly susceptible to PFOS accumulation, which may lead to changes in liver-specific protein profiles, increased immune cell populations, and structural damage, ultimately causing fibrosis and impairing immune function.
outcome: 健康与生理状态（肝脏损伤、免疫功能）

quote: The best results were in fish fed diets containing 28.9% protein values declined PER in fish fed diets containing more than 28.9% crude protein.
statement: 喂食含28.9%蛋白质的饲料可获得最佳结果，而蛋白质含量超过28.9%会导致蛋白质效率比（PER）下降。
text_zh: 喂食含28.9%蛋白质的饲料可获得最佳结果，而蛋白质含量超过28.9%会导致蛋白质效率比（PER）下降。
text_en: Feeding a diet containing 28.9% protein yields the best results, while protein levels exceeding 28.9% lead to a decrease in the Protein Efficiency Ratio (PER).

quote: The survival rates more were achieved to treatments that used water recirculation system, fed artemia and water static system, fed ration, but were not significantly different between all tested treatments (p>0.05).
statement: 使用循环水系统投喂卤虫和处理组以及静态水系统投喂商业饲料的处理组获得了最高的存活率，但所有测试处理组之间没有显著差异。
text_zh: 使用循环水系统投喂卤虫和处理组以及静态水系统投喂商业饲料的处理组获得了最高的存活率，但所有测试处理组之间没有显著差异。
text_en: The treatment group using a recirculating aquaculture system fed with Artemia and the treatment group using a static water system fed with commercial feed achieved the highest survival rates, but there was no significant difference among all tested treatment groups.

population.system: 循环水系统; 静态水系统

quote: Survival was independent of any diet.
statement: 存活率不受任何饮食的影响。
text_zh: 存活率不受任何饮食的影响。
text_en: Survival rate was not affected by any diet.

quote: Another problem regarding the use of brine shrimp biomass as food is the high input of organic matter into the aquaculture system, which may favor bacterial growth.
statement: 使用卤虫生物量作为饲料会导致养殖系统中有机物质输入过高，这可能有利于细菌生长。
text_zh: 使用卤虫生物量作为饲料会导致养殖系统中有机物质输入过高，这可能有利于细菌生长。
text_en: Using Artemia biomass as feed leads to excessive organic matter input in the farming system, which may favor bacterial growth.

quote: Several bacterial general have been associated with diseases in fish, oftenly originating from the given food (Ju et al., 2007).
statement: 几种细菌属与鱼类疾病有关，通常源自所给的食物。
text_zh: 几种细菌属与鱼类疾病有关，通常源自所给的食物。
text_en: Several bacterial genera are associated with fish diseases, typically originating from the feed provided.

quote: Bacterial disease is the most common infectious problem of ornamental fishes. Collectively, only water quality problems exceed bacterial diseases in the area of pet fish morbidity and mortality.
statement: 细菌性疾病是观赏鱼最常见的感染问题。总体而言，只有水质问题在宠物鱼的发病率和死亡率方面超过细菌性疾病。
text_zh: 细菌性疾病是观赏鱼最常见的感染问题。总体而言，只有水质问题在宠物鱼的发病率和死亡率方面超过细菌性疾病。
text_en: Bacterial diseases are the most common infection problem in ornamental fish. Overall, only water quality issues exceed bacterial diseases in terms of morbidity and mortality in pet fish.

quote: The development of efficient culture systems that preserve water quality is higly needed. Therefore, the use of closed of recirculating water systems is becoming one of the alternatives for aquaculture (Colt et al., 2006; Gutierrez-Wing and Malone, 2006).
statement: 开发能保持水质的有效养殖系统非常必要。因此，使用封闭或循环水系统正成为水产养殖的替代方案之一。
text_zh: 开发能保持水质的有效养殖系统非常必要。因此，使用封闭或循环水系统正成为水产养殖的替代方案之一。
text_en: It is very necessary to develop effective aquaculture systems that can maintain water quality. Therefore, the use of closed or recirculating water systems is becoming one of the alternatives for aquaculture.

quote:
Halachmi (2006) developed a
simulation model for determining the optimal
layout and management regime for orna-mental fish recirculating aquaculture system.
statement: Halachmi (2006)开发了一个模拟模型，用于确定观赏鱼循环水养殖系统的最佳布局和管理制度。
text_zh: Halachmi (2006)开发了一个模拟模型，用于确定观赏鱼循环水养殖系统的最佳布局和管理制度。
text_en: Halachmi (2006) developed a simulation model to determine the optimal layout and management regime for recirculating aquaculture systems for ornamental fish.

quote:
Treatments
RA and RR used a 1000 l/hour filtering and
pumping system equipped with mechanical
(glass wool), biological (bacterial biofilm
adhered to 3 cm in diameter granite rocks)
and chemical (activated coal) filtration.
statement: 处理组RA和RR使用了配备机械（玻璃棉）、生物（附着在直径3厘米花岗岩上的细菌生物膜）和化学（活性炭）过滤的1000升/小时过滤和泵送系统。
text_zh: 处理组RA和RR使用了配备机械（玻璃棉）、生物（附着在直径3厘米花岗岩上的细菌生物膜）和化学（活性炭）过滤的1000升/小时过滤和泵送系统。
text_en: Treatment groups RA and RR used a 1000 L/hour filtration and pumping system equipped with mechanical (glass wool), biological (bacterial biofilm attached to 3 cm diameter granite), and chemical (activated carbon) filtration.

quote:
For the static water systems a constant aeration
was provided by a portable airpump
connected to airstones.
statement: 对于静水系统，通过连接到气石的便携式气泵提供持续曝气。
text_zh: 对于静水系统，通过连接到气石的便携式气泵提供持续曝气。
text_en: For static water systems, constant aeration is provided by portable air pumps connected to air stones.

quote:
Initial stock density
in all treatments was ten animals per tank.
statement: The initial stocking density in all treatments was ten animals per tank.
text_en: The initial stocking density in all treatments was ten animals per tank.

quote:
Frozen brine shrimp biomass was used as
natural food source, while the commercial
diet was composed by textured soy protein,
fish meal, wheat flour, fresh shrimp, corn
meal, seaweed meal, dehydrated carrot,
dehydrated spinach, yeast, soybean oil,
Spirulina, prebiotic additive, salt, additive
enzyme, vitamin mineral premix, astaxanthin,
natural dyes, organic minerals chelated
stabilized vitamin C and antioxidant,
statement: Frozen brine shrimp biomass was used as a natural food source, while a specific commercial diet composition was also used.
text_en: Frozen brine shrimp biomass was used as a natural food source, while a specific commercial diet composition was also used.

quote:
Both tested diets were
offered at 8% of the total biomass, in two
meals per day, six day a week.
statement: Both tested diets were offered at 8% of the total biomass, in two meals per day, six days a week.
text_en: Both tested diets were offered at 8% of the total biomass, in two meals per day, six days a week.

quote:
Biometrics occurred every two weeks,
zootechnical performances were evaluated
regarding average weight growth, total
length growth, weight gain (%), specific
growth rate (%) and survival rate,
statement: Biometrics occurred every two weeks, and zootechnical performances were evaluated regarding growth metrics and survival rate.
text_en: Biometrics occurred every two weeks, and zootechnical performances were evaluated regarding growth metrics and survival rate.

quote: The results of the present study indicated that the different culture systems (static and recirculation) had no effect on the zootechnical performance of cultured fish.
statement: A presente pesquisa indicou que os diferentes sistemas de cultivo (estático e recirculação) não tiveram efeito sobre o desempenho zootécnico dos peixes cultivados.
text_en: A presente pesquisa indicou que os diferentes sistemas de cultivo (estático e recirculação) não tiveram efeito sobre o desempenho zootécnico dos peixes cultivados.

quote: However, water recirculation systems, become a viable alternative when the associated energy costs, because the constant water flow keeps water temperature stable (minimizing the use of thermostats) and adequate oxygen levels in the water, decreasing the need for artificial aeration.
statement: Os sistemas de recirculação de água tornam-se uma alternativa viável devido aos custos energéticos associados, pois o fluxo constante de água mantém a temperatura da água estável (minimizando o uso de termostatos) e níveis adequados de oxigênio na água, diminuindo a necessidade de aeração artificial.
text_en: Os sistemas de recirculação de água tornam-se uma alternativa viável devido aos custos energéticos associados, pois o fluxo constante de água mantém a temperatura da água estável (minimizando o uso de termostatos) e níveis adequados de oxigênio na água, diminuindo a necessidade de aeração artificial.

quote: By exposing juvenile crucian carp to different levels of PFOS for 21 days, we observed significant liver damage, including vein congestion, cell breakdown, and the formation of empty spaces within cells.
statement: 将幼年鲫鱼暴露于不同水平的PFOS中21天，观察到显著的肝脏损伤，包括静脉充血、细胞破裂和细胞内空泡形成。
text_zh: 将幼年鲫鱼暴露于不同水平的PFOS中21天，观察到显著的肝脏损伤，包括静脉充血、细胞破裂和细胞内空泡形成。
text_en: Exposing juvenile crucian carp to different levels of PFOS for 21 days resulted in significant liver damage, including venous congestion, cell rupture, and intracellular vacuole formation.

quote: Transcriptomic analysis revealed that PFOS impacts genes involved in lipid processing, energy production, infection response, and hormone regulation.
statement: 转录组分析显示，PFOS影响参与脂质加工、能量产生、感染反应和激素调节的基因。
text_zh: 转录组分析显示，PFOS影响参与脂质加工、能量产生、感染反应和激素调节的基因。
text_en: Transcriptome analysis showed that PFOS affects genes involved in lipid processing, energy production, infection response, and hormone regulation.

quote: These changes suggest that PFOS disrupts multiple body systems in fish, leading to conditions similar to fatty liver disease in humans.
statement: 这些变化表明PFOS破坏了鱼类的多个身体系统，导致类似人类脂肪肝疾病的状况。
text_zh: 这些变化表明PFOS破坏了鱼类的多个身体系统，导致类似人类脂肪肝疾病的状况。
text_en: These changes indicate that PFOS disrupts multiple body systems in fish, leading to conditions similar to human fatty liver disease.

quote: The use of artificial feed requires special care since their nutritional composition to the frequency of feeding.
statement: O uso de ração artificial exige cuidados especiais devido à sua composição nutricional e frequência de alimentação.
text_en: O uso de ração artificial exige cuidados especiais devido à sua composição nutricional e frequência de alimentação.

quote: The brine shrimp biomass proved to be more effective, but its more expensive, difficult to storage and can serve as a substrate for potential pathogens, what can limit its use.
statement: A biomassa de Artemia provou ser mais eficaz, mas é mais cara, difícil de armazenar e pode servir como substrato para patógenos potenciais, o que pode limitar seu uso.
text_en: A biomassa de Artemia provou ser mais eficaz, mas é mais cara, difícil de armazenar e pode servir como substrato para patógenos potenciais, o que pode limitar seu uso.
outcome: eficácia alimentar e risco de patógenos
limitations: custo elevado, dificuldade de armazenamento, risco de patógenos
counterevidence: pode servir como substrato para patógenos potenciais

quote: The static water system with the administration of natural food presented the highest number of bacteria in comparison to the recirculation system with provision of commercial food, what lead us to believe that brine shrimp is a possible vehicle for microorganisms contamination.
statement: O sistema de água estática com administração de alimento natural apresentou o maior número de bactérias em comparação ao sistema de recirculação com fornecimento de ração comercial, o que nos leva a acreditar que a Artemia é um possível veículo de contaminação por microrganismos.
text_en: O sistema de água estática com administração de alimento natural apresentou o maior número de bactérias em comparação ao sistema de recirculação com fornecimento de ração comercial, o que nos leva a acreditar que a Artemia é um possível veículo de contaminação por microrganismos.
counterevidence: maior número de bactérias comparado ao sistema de recirculação com ração comercial

quote: Throughout this period, critical water parameters were maintained within optimal ranges: dissolved oxygen (DO) ≥ 5 mg/L, a pH of 7.0 ± 0.5, a controlled temperature of 25 ± 1 °C, and a photoperiod set to 14 h of light followed by 10 h of darkness.
statement: 在适应期内，溶解氧、pH值、温度和光周期等关键水质参数被维持在最佳范围内。
text_zh: 在适应期内，溶解氧、pH值、温度和光周期等关键水质参数被维持在最佳范围内。
text_en: During the acclimation period, key water quality parameters such as dissolved oxygen, pH, temperature, and photoperiod were maintained within optimal ranges.

quote: In addition, fish are fed commercial feed equivalent to 6.0% of their body weight every day to ensure continuous nutritional support, 50% of the water was replaced every day, and dead fish and residual bait were removed in time to maintain good water quality [ 31 ].
statement: 每天按体重6.0%投喂商业饲料以确保营养支持，每天更换50%的水，并及时清除死鱼和残饵以保持良好的水质。
text_zh: 每天按体重6.0%投喂商业饲料以确保营养支持，每天更换50%的水，并及时清除死鱼和残饵以保持良好的水质。
text_en: Commercial feed was provided daily at 6.0% of body weight to ensure nutritional support, 50% of the water was changed daily, and dead fish and leftover feed were removed promptly to maintain good water quality.

quote: Euthanasia was performed using an overdose of tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222), following the recommended concentration and exposure time to ensure the rapid and painless termination of life.
statement: 使用过量三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）进行安乐死，遵循推荐的浓度和暴露时间，以确保快速且无痛地终止生命。
text_zh: 使用过量三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）进行安乐死，遵循推荐的浓度和暴露时间，以确保快速且无痛地终止生命。
text_en: Euthanasia using an overdose of tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222), following recommended concentrations and exposure times, to ensure rapid and painless termination of life.

quote: For goldfish, the best results were achieved with C. vulgaris and H. pluvialis.
statement: 对于金鱼，使用小球藻和雨生红球藻取得了最佳效果。
text_zh: 对于金鱼，使用小球藻和雨生红球藻取得了最佳效果。
text_en: For goldfish, the best results were obtained using Chlorella and Haematococcus pluvialis.

quote: Animals fed the diet containing fish meal had better results than those fed the diet containing meat and bone.
statement: 喂食含鱼粉日粮的动物比喂食含肉骨粉日粮的动物表现更好。
text_zh: 喂食含鱼粉日粮的动物比喂食含肉骨粉日粮的动物表现更好。
text_en: Animals fed a diet containing fish meal performed better than animals fed a diet containing meat and bone meal.
intervention: Fish meal vs meat and bone meal diet
intervention_record: 鱼粉与肉骨粉日粮对比

quote: The squid extract had the strongest stimulating effect among all the attractants tested.
statement: 在所有测试的诱食剂中，鱿鱼提取物具有最强的刺激作用。
text_zh: 在所有测试的诱食剂中，鱿鱼提取物具有最强的刺激作用。
text_en: Among all tested attractants, squid extract had the strongest stimulating effect.

quote: In the recirculation system the levels of total ammonia and nitrite were significantly lower than in static water system (p<0.05) as shown in table III.
statement: 循环水系统中的总氨和亚硝酸盐水平显著低于静水系统。
text_zh: 循环水系统中的总氨和亚硝酸盐水平显著低于静水系统。
text_en: Total ammonia and nitrite levels in the recirculating aquaculture system were significantly lower than those in the static water system.
outcome: 水质指标（氨氮和亚硝酸盐）

quote: Recent studies have demonstrated pronounced hepatotoxic effects of PFOS in mammals [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] and fish [ 19 ], impacting various biological functions.
statement: 近期研究表明PFOS对哺乳动物和鱼类具有显著的肝毒性，影响多种生物学功能。
text_zh: 近期研究表明PFOS对哺乳动物和鱼类具有显著的肝毒性，影响多种生物学功能。
text_en: Recent studies have shown that PFOS has significant hepatotoxicity in mammals and fish, affecting multiple biological functions.

quote: Additionally, chronic exposure has been shown to shrink the liver and affect energy metabolism in carp [ 25 ].
statement: 此外，慢性暴露已被证明会导致鲤鱼肝脏萎缩并影响能量代谢。
text_zh: 此外，慢性暴露已被证明会导致鲤鱼肝脏萎缩并影响能量代谢。
text_en: In addition, chronic exposure has been shown to cause liver atrophy in carp and affect energy metabolism.

quote: This study aimed to elucidate the toxicological impacts of PFOS on crucian carp through acute and chronic toxicity assays using juvenile specimens.
statement: 本研究旨在通过幼鱼标本的急性和慢性毒性试验阐明全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）对鲫鱼毒理学影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在通过幼鱼标本的急性和慢性毒性试验阐明全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）对鲫鱼毒理学影响。
text_en: This study aims to elucidate the toxicological effects of perfluorooctane sulfonate (PFOS) on crucian carp through acute and chronic toxicity tests using juvenile fish specimens.

quote:
RA: water recirculating system, fed artemia; RR: water recirculating systems, fed commercial ration;
SR: water static system, fed artemia; SA: water static system, fed commercial ration.
statement: O estudo define quatro tratamentos experimentais combinando sistemas de cultivo (recirculação ou estático) com dietas (artêmia ou ração comercial).
text_en: O estudo define quatro tratamentos experimentais combinando sistemas de cultivo (recirculação ou estático) com dietas (artêmia ou ração comercial).

statement: Os juvenis alimentados com artêmia (grupos RA e SR) apresentaram peso final significativamente maior do que os alimentados com ração comercial (grupos RR e SA), independentemente do sistema de cultivo.
text_en: Os juvenis alimentados com artêmia (grupos RA e SR) apresentaram peso final significativamente maior do que os alimentados com ração comercial (grupos RR e SA), independentemente do sistema de cultivo.

statement: O ganho de peso percentual foi significativamente superior nos grupos alimentados com artêmia em comparação aos grupos alimentados com ração comercial.
text_en: O ganho de peso percentual foi significativamente superior nos grupos alimentados com artêmia em comparação aos grupos alimentados com ração comercial.

statement: A taxa específica de crescimento foi significativamente maior nos peixes alimentados com artêmia do que naqueles alimentados com ração comercial.
text_en: A taxa específica de crescimento foi significativamente maior nos peixes alimentados com artêmia do que naqueles alimentados com ração comercial.

statement: As taxas de sobrevivência não diferiram estatisticamente entre os diferentes sistemas de cultivo ou dietas testadas.
text_en: As taxas de sobrevivência não diferiram estatisticamente entre os diferentes sistemas de cultivo ou dietas testadas.

statement: Os sistemas de recirculação de água (RA e RR) mantiveram níveis de amônia total próximos a zero, enquanto os sistemas de água estática (SR e SA) apresentaram concentrações significativamente mais altas de amônia.
text_en: Os sistemas de recirculação de água (RA e RR) mantiveram níveis de amônia total próximos a zero, enquanto os sistemas de água estática (SR e SA) apresentaram concentrações significativamente mais altas de amônia.

statement: O grupo SA (sistema estático, ração comercial) apresentou concentração de nitrito significativamente maior do que os outros grupos, incluindo o grupo SR (estático, artêmia) que não diferiu dos sistemas de recirculação.
text_en: O grupo SA (sistema estático, ração comercial) apresentou concentração de nitrito significativamente maior do que os outros grupos, incluindo o grupo SR (estático, artêmia) que não diferiu dos sistemas de recirculação.
counterevidence: O sistema estático com artêmia (SR) não mostrou diferença significativa em relação aos sistemas de recirculação para nitrito.

text_zh: 某些观赏鱼在初次摄食时体型过小，无法摄入卤虫无节幼体或水蚤。
text_en: Some ornamental fish are too small at first feeding to ingest brine shrimp nauplii or water fleas.

quote: Ornamental fishes have tradi- tionally been fed live food, which in many cases can be nutritionally deficient, and act as a source of diseases (parasitic, bacterial and viral).
statement: 传统上给观赏鱼投喂的活饵在许多情况下营养不足，并且可能成为寄生虫、细菌和病毒疾病的来源。
text_zh: 传统上给观赏鱼投喂的活饵在许多情况下营养不足，并且可能成为寄生虫、细菌和病毒疾病的来源。
text_en: Live feed traditionally given to ornamental fish is nutritionally insufficient in many cases and may be a source of parasitic, bacterial, and viral diseases.

quote: Sales and Janssens (2003), investigated some nutritional requirements (protein and minerals) for growing freshwater ornamental species (live-bearers) with emphasis on the provision of live feed during the early stages of life.
statement: 研究调查了生长中的淡水卵胎生观赏物种的营养需求，重点在于生命早期阶段提供活饵。
text_zh: 研究调查了生长中的淡水卵胎生观赏物种的营养需求，重点在于生命早期阶段提供活饵。
text_en: The study investigated the nutritional requirements of growing freshwater live-bearing ornamental species, focusing on providing live feed during the early life stages.

quote: Bandyopadhyay et al. (2005) feeding juvenile goldfish obtained results better when fed protein levels the 42.53%.
statement: 当喂食42.53%的蛋白质水平时，幼年金鱼的饲养效果更佳。
text_zh: 当喂食42.53%的蛋白质水平时，幼年金鱼的饲养效果更佳。
text_en: When fed a protein level of 42.53%, the rearing performance of juvenile goldfish was better.

quote: Artemia is widely used in countries that practice commercial aquaculture due to its easiness of use or due its nutritional properties which are essential to many aquatic species during some stages of their life cycle (Barros and Valenti, 2003).
statement: 由于易于使用或其对许多水生生物生命周期某些阶段至关重要的营养特性，卤虫在从事商业水产养殖的国家被广泛使用。
text_zh: 由于易于使用或其对许多水生生物生命周期某些阶段至关重要的营养特性，卤虫在从事商业水产养殖的国家被广泛使用。
text_en: Artemia is widely used in countries engaged in commercial aquaculture due to its ease of use or its nutritional properties that are essential for certain stages of the life cycle of many aquatic organisms.

quote: This microcrustacean is among the most used foods for ornamental fish, provided either live (nauplius) or frozen (adult).
statement: 这种微甲壳类动物是观赏鱼最常用的食物之一，以活的（无节幼体）或冷冻的（成体）形式提供。
text_zh: 这种微甲壳类动物是观赏鱼最常用的食物之一，以活的（无节幼体）或冷冻的（成体）形式提供。
text_en: This micro-crustacean is one of the most commonly used foods for ornamental fish, provided in live (nauplius) or frozen (adult) form.

quote: Prior to sampling, fish underwent a 24 h fasting period.
statement: 在采样前，鱼经历了24小时的禁食期。
text_zh: 在采样前，鱼经历了24小时的禁食期。
text_en: Before sampling, the fish underwent a 24-hour fasting period.

quote: Liver tissues were carefully extracted on ice from all fish.
statement: 从所有鱼身上小心地在冰上提取肝组织。
text_zh: 从所有鱼身上小心地在冰上提取肝组织。
text_en: Liver tissue was carefully extracted from all fish on ice.

quote: This approach ensures compliance with international standards for the humane treatment of laboratory animals.
statement: 该方法确保符合实验室动物人道待遇的国际标准。
text_zh: 该方法确保符合实验室动物人道待遇的国际标准。
text_en: This method ensures compliance with international standards for the humane treatment of laboratory animals.

quote: Before starting the experiment, the fish were fasted for 24 h to standardize their physiological conditions.
statement: 实验开始前，鱼禁食24小时以标准化其生理状况。
text_zh: 实验开始前，鱼禁食24小时以标准化其生理状况。
text_en: Before the experiment started, fish were fasted for 24 hours to standardize their physiological condition.

quote: During the 96 h test, we maintained consistent water conditions without feeding or changing the exposure solution
statement: 在96小时测试期间，保持水质条件一致，不喂食也不更换暴露溶液。
text_zh: 在96小时测试期间，保持水质条件一致，不喂食也不更换暴露溶液。
text_en: During the 96-hour test, water quality conditions were kept consistent, with no feeding and no replacement of the exposure solution.
intervention: Static exposure without water change or feeding
intervention_record: 静态暴露不换水不喂食

quote: Fish were considered dead if they did not respond to gentle stimulation at the tail.
statement: 如果鱼对尾部轻柔刺激无反应，则视为死亡。
text_zh: 如果鱼对尾部轻柔刺激无反应，则视为死亡。
text_en: If the fish does not respond to gentle tail stimulation, it is considered dead.

quote: Dead fish were removed promptly throughout the experiment.
statement: 在整个实验过程中及时移除死鱼。
text_zh: 在整个实验过程中及时移除死鱼。
text_en: Dead fish were promptly removed throughout the entire experiment.

quote: Further magnification to 100× disclosed signs of nuclear lysis in some hepatocytes of the treatment groups, characterized by pale staining and displacement alongside nuclear membranes, with the 1 mg/L group exhibiting notable nucleolus dissolution and disappearance (green arrows indicate these instances) (Figure 1 (B3,C3,D3)).
statement: 进一步放大至100倍显示，处理组部分肝细胞出现核溶解迹象，表现为淡染和沿核膜位移，其中1 mg/L组表现出明显的核仁溶解和消失。
text_zh: 进一步放大至100倍显示，处理组部分肝细胞出现核溶解迹象，表现为淡染和沿核膜位移，其中1 mg/L组表现出明显的核仁溶解和消失。
text_en: Further magnified 100 times, some hepatocytes in the treatment group showed signs of karyolysis, manifested as pale staining and displacement along the nuclear membrane, with the 1 mg/L group exhibiting obvious nucleolar dissolution and disappearance.

quote: These histological transformations undeniably illustrate that chronic PFOS exposure inflicts liver impairment in crucian carp, with the severity of hepatic histopathology escalating in parallel with PFOS concentration increments, thereby accentuating the dose-responsive hepatotoxic impact of PFOS on this species.
statement: Chronic PFOS exposure causes liver impairment in crucian carp, with severity increasing as PFOS concentration rises.
text_en: Chronic PFOS exposure causes liver impairment in crucian carp, with severity increasing as PFOS concentration rises.

quote: In the current paper, high nitrogen levels found in the static system did not interfere on the zootechnical performance of cultured fish.
statement: Neste estudo, os altos níveis de nitrogênio encontrados no sistema estático não interferiram no desempenho zootécnico dos peixes cultivados.
text_en: Neste estudo, os altos níveis de nitrogênio encontrados no sistema estático não interferiram no desempenho zootécnico dos peixes cultivados.

quote: The same author affirm that goldfish larvae require specific requirements of the physical, chemical and biological water to enhance their survival and maximize growth.
statement: O mesmo autor afirma que as larvas de peixe-dourado requerem requisitos específicos da água física, química e biológica para aumentar sua sobrevivência e maximizar o crescimento.
text_en: O mesmo autor afirma que as larvas de peixe-dourado requerem requisitos específicos da água física, química e biológica para aumentar sua sobrevivência e maximizar o crescimento.

quote: In contrast, these can be vehicles of many microorganisms that can be pathogenic (Olafsen, 2001).
statement: Em contraste, estes podem ser veículos de muitos microrganismos que podem ser patogênicos.
text_en: Em contraste, estes podem ser veículos de muitos microrganismos que podem ser patogênicos.

quote: These results illuminate potential disruptions in biological processes and disease correlations linked to rising PFOS concentrations in crucian carp.
statement: 研究结果表明，随着鲫鱼体内PFOS浓度的升高，可能存在生物过程紊乱和疾病相关性。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，随着鲫鱼体内PFOS浓度的升高，可能存在生物过程紊乱和疾病相关性。
text_en: The research results indicate that as PFOS concentrations in crucian carp increase, there may be a correlation with biological process disorders and disease.

quote: These changes provide compelling evidence that PFOS may disrupt pathways of glucose synthesis, fatty acid oxidation, and lipid synthesis/storage in the hepatic parenchyma, potentially triggering nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).
statement: 这些变化提供了有力证据，表明PFOS可能破坏肝实质中的葡萄糖合成、脂肪酸氧化以及脂质合成/储存通路，从而可能引发非酒精性脂肪肝（NAFLD）。
text_zh: 这些变化提供了有力证据，表明PFOS可能破坏肝实质中的葡萄糖合成、脂肪酸氧化以及脂质合成/储存通路，从而可能引发非酒精性脂肪肝（NAFLD）。
text_en: These changes provide strong evidence that PFOS may disrupt glucose synthesis, fatty acid oxidation, and lipid synthesis/storage pathways in the liver parenchyma, thereby potentially inducing non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).

quote: Furthermore, dysregulation of certain genes appears to exacerbate hepatocyte apoptosis, fibrosis, and inflammation, leading to liver injury.
statement: 基因失调加剧肝细胞凋亡、纤维化和炎症，导致肝损伤。
text_zh: 基因失调加剧肝细胞凋亡、纤维化和炎症，导致肝损伤。
text_en: Gene dysregulation exacerbates hepatocyte apoptosis, fibrosis and inflammation, leading to liver injury.

quote: For instance, upregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokine genes such as interleukin-1 (IL-1), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and interferon-alpha (INF-alpha) supports the development of NAFLD [ 64 , 65 ].
statement: 促炎细胞因子基因的上调支持非酒精性脂肪肝的发展。
text_zh: 促炎细胞因子基因的上调支持非酒精性脂肪肝的发展。
text_en: The upregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokine genes supports the development of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.

quote: The effect of Contracaecum sp. on the health of their host was determined by estimating the effect of the parasites’ presence, number, and biomass on fish length, weight, and the Fulton’s condition factor (CF).
statement: Contracaecum sp.对宿主健康的影响通过估计寄生虫的存在、数量和生物量对鱼体长、体重和肥满度（CF）的影响来确定。
text_zh: Contracaecum sp.对宿主健康的影响通过估计寄生虫的存在、数量和生物量对鱼体长、体重和肥满度（CF）的影响来确定。
text_en: The impact of Contracaecum sp. on host health was determined by estimating the effects of parasite presence, abundance, and biomass on fish body length, weight, and condition factor (CF).
outcome: 健康状况指标（体长、体重、肥满度）

quote: Infected fish showed negative (b p b > 3; p U test: U = 1078.00, U = 423.50, respectively; p
statement: 受感染的鱼表现出负相关结果（具体统计值显示显著性）。
text_zh: 受感染的鱼表现出负相关结果（具体统计值显示显著性）。
text_en: Infected fish showed negatively correlated results (specific statistical values indicate significance).

quote: Hence, based on our findings, PFOS exhibits moderate toxicity towards crucian carp under the given experimental conditions.
statement: 因此，基于我们的发现，在给定的实验条件下，PFOS对鲫鱼表现出中等毒性。
text_zh: 因此，基于我们的发现，在给定的实验条件下，PFOS对鲫鱼表现出中等毒性。
text_en: Therefore, based on our findings, PFOS exhibits moderate toxicity to crucian carp under the given experimental conditions.

quote: Upon examination with 25× magnification, hepatocytes in the treatment cohorts revealed steatosis, evidenced by variable-sized intracellular lipid droplets, notably in the 1 mg/L group where large droplets displaced nuclei to the cellular periphery (indicated by red arrows) (Figure 1 (B1,C1,D1)).
statement: 在25倍放大下，处理组的肝细胞显示出脂肪变性，表现为大小不一的细胞内脂滴，特别是在1 mg/L组中，大脂滴将核推至细胞边缘。
text_zh: 在25倍放大下，处理组的肝细胞显示出脂肪变性，表现为大小不一的细胞内脂滴，特别是在1 mg/L组中，大脂滴将核推至细胞边缘。
text_en: At 25x magnification, hepatocytes in the treatment group showed steatosis, manifested as intracellular lipid droplets of varying sizes; particularly in the 1 mg/L group, large lipid droplets displaced the nucleus to the cell periphery.

quote: Enhanced observation at 50× unveiled central vein dilation, hemoglobin cell compression, and deformation in the 0.5 mg/L group (yellow arrows denote these features) (Figure 1 (B2,C2,D2)).
statement: 在50倍放大下的增强观察显示，0.5 mg/L组出现中央静脉扩张、血红蛋白细胞压缩和变形。
text_zh: 在50倍放大下的增强观察显示，0.5 mg/L组出现中央静脉扩张、血红蛋白细胞压缩和变形。
text_en: Enhanced observation at 50x magnification showed central vein dilation, hemoglobin cell compression and deformation in the 0.5 mg/L group.
outcome: 肝脏血管及血细胞形态

quote: Across all treated groups, hepatocytes exhibited mild swelling, size incrementation, cytoplasmic staining, thinning, and either a reticular or translucent appearance; vacuolation was noted alongside the loss of normal morphology and a looser cellular array, a trend exacerbated with elevated PFOS concentrations (Figure 1 (B2,C2,D2)).
statement: 在所有处理组中，肝细胞表现出轻度肿胀、体积增大、胞质染色变浅以及网状或半透明外观；观察到空泡化伴随正常形态丧失和细胞排列疏松，且随着PFOS浓度升高这一趋势加剧。
text_zh: 在所有处理组中，肝细胞表现出轻度肿胀、体积增大、胞质染色变浅以及网状或半透明外观；观察到空泡化伴随正常形态丧失和细胞排列疏松，且随着PFOS浓度升高这一趋势加剧。
text_en: In all treatment groups, hepatocytes exhibited mild swelling, increased volume, lighter cytoplasmic staining, and a reticular or translucent appearance; vacuolation was observed accompanied by loss of normal morphology and loose cell arrangement, and this trend intensified with increasing PFOS concentration.
outcome: 肝细胞形态与结构完整性

quote: Parasitic infection can cause a variety of pathological changes which can be quite detrimental to the fish health, including tissue damage, organ obstruction, and nutrient deprivation
statement: 寄生虫感染会导致多种病理变化，对鱼类健康有害，包括组织损伤、器官阻塞和营养缺乏。
text_zh: 寄生虫感染会导致多种病理变化，对鱼类健康有害，包括组织损伤、器官阻塞和营养缺乏。
text_en: Parasitic infections cause various pathological changes that are harmful to fish health, including tissue damage, organ blockage, and nutritional deficiency.

quote: Consequently, infected fish may differ from the healthy fish, through the values of Fulton’s condition factor, length–weight relationship, indicating the severeness of infection.
statement: 受感染的鱼可能通过Fulton条件因子和长度-重量关系的数值与健康鱼不同，这些指标指示了感染的严重程度。
text_zh: 受感染的鱼可能通过Fulton条件因子和长度-重量关系的数值与健康鱼不同，这些指标指示了感染的严重程度。
text_en: Infected fish may differ from healthy fish in the values of the Fulton condition factor and length-weight relationship, which indicate the severity of infection.

quote: Changed values and ratios can indicate future disturbances in the growth rate and reproductive success
statement: 变化的数值和比率可以预示未来生长率和繁殖成功率的干扰。
text_zh: 变化的数值和比率可以预示未来生长率和繁殖成功率的干扰。
text_en: Changes in values and ratios can predict disturbances in future growth rates and reproductive success.

quote: verify possible negative effects of parasites on fish health by evaluating variances in Fulton’s condition factor and length–weight relationships between healthy and infected individuals
statement: 研究旨在通过评估健康个体与感染个体之间Fulton肥满度和长度-重量关系的差异，来验证寄生虫对鱼类健康的潜在负面影响。
text_zh: 研究旨在通过评估健康个体与感染个体之间Fulton肥满度和长度-重量关系的差异，来验证寄生虫对鱼类健康的潜在负面影响。
text_en: The study aims to verify the potential negative effects of parasites on fish health by assessing differences in Fulton condition factor and length-weight relationships between healthy and infected individuals.
intervention: Fulton condition factor and length-weight relationship
intervention_record: 肥满度与体长体重关系

quote: None of them harbored any macroscopic ectoparasites; however, 20 individuals were infected with the nematode endoparasite identified as Contracaecum sp. third stage larvae, Type II
statement: 在检查的199条普鲁士鲤鱼中，没有发现宏观体外寄生虫，但有20条感染了被鉴定为Contracaecum属第三期幼虫II型的线虫体内寄生虫。
text_zh: 在检查的199条普鲁士鲤鱼中，没有发现宏观体外寄生虫，但有20条感染了被鉴定为Contracaecum属第三期幼虫II型的线虫体内寄生虫。
text_en: Among the 199 Prussian carp examined, no macroscopic ectoparasites were found, but 20 were infected with nematode endoparasites identified as Contracaecum genus third-stage larvae type II.

quote: Our study echoes these findings, implicating oxidative stress-induced lipid peroxidation and disturbed glycolipid metabolism as contributors to vacuolation and triglyceride (TG) accumulation [ 48 , 49 ].
statement: 我们的研究证实了这些发现，指出氧化应激诱导的脂质过氧化和糖脂代谢紊乱是导致空泡化和甘油三酯（TG）积累的原因。
text_zh: 我们的研究证实了这些发现，指出氧化应激诱导的脂质过氧化和糖脂代谢紊乱是导致空泡化和甘油三酯（TG）积累的原因。
text_en: Our study confirmed these findings, indicating that oxidative stress-induced lipid peroxidation and glycolipid metabolic disorders are the causes of vacuolization and triglyceride (TG) accumulation.

quote: Calculations of length–weight relationships showed differences in growth between infected and uninfected fish, evident in coefficient b values, with infected fish showing negative allometric growth (b = 2.00; H 0 : b = 3 rejected at the 0.05 significance level), and uninfected fish positive allometric growth (b = 3.32; H 0 : b = 3 rejected at the 0.05 significance level).
statement: 感染Contracaecum sp.的普鲁士鲤鱼表现出负异速生长，而未感染的鱼表现出正异速生长。
text_zh: 感染Contracaecum sp.的普鲁士鲤鱼表现出负异速生长，而未感染的鱼表现出正异速生长。
text_en: Prussian carp infected with Contracaecum sp. exhibited negative allometric growth, while uninfected fish exhibited positive allometric growth.

quote: Fish weight and Fulton’s condition factor in infected individuals were significantly low in comparison to the uninfected ones (Mann–Whitney U test: U = 1078.00, p = 0.004; U = 423.50, p = 0.000, respectively).
statement: 感染个体的鱼体重和Fulton肥满度显著低于未感染个体。
text_zh: 感染个体的鱼体重和Fulton肥满度显著低于未感染个体。
text_en: The body weight and Fulton condition factor of infected individuals were significantly lower than those of uninfected individuals.

quote: Notably, significant alterations were observed in pathways related to oxidative phosphorylation, neurodegeneration, thermogenesis, chemical carcinogenesis involving reactive oxygen species, and the citric acid cycle.
statement: PFOS exposure导致与氧化磷酸化、神经退行性变、产热、涉及活性氧的化学致癌作用以及三羧酸循环相关的通路发生显著改变。
text_zh: PFOS exposure导致与氧化磷酸化、神经退行性变、产热、涉及活性氧的化学致癌作用以及三羧酸循环相关的通路发生显著改变。
text_en: PFOS exposure caused significant changes in pathways related to oxidative phosphorylation, neurodegeneration, thermogenesis, chemical carcinogenesis involving reactive oxygen species, and the tricarboxylic acid cycle.

quote: Key pathways affected include those associated with the endocrine system, lipid metabolism, immune response, and amino acid metabolism.
statement: 受影响的关键通路包括与内分泌系统、脂质代谢、免疫反应和氨基酸代谢相关的通路。
text_zh: 受影响的关键通路包括与内分泌系统、脂质代谢、免疫反应和氨基酸代谢相关的通路。
text_en: The affected key pathways include those related to the endocrine system, lipid metabolism, immune response, and amino acid metabolism.

quote: This study provides a comprehensive evaluation of PFOS toxicity in crucian carp using acute toxicity assays, histopathology, and transcriptomics.
statement: 本研究通过急性毒性试验、组织病理学和转录组学对鲫鱼中的PFOS毒性进行了全面评估。
text_zh: 本研究通过急性毒性试验、组织病理学和转录组学对鲫鱼中的PFOS毒性进行了全面评估。
text_en: This study comprehensively evaluated PFOS toxicity in crucian carp through acute toxicity tests, histopathology and transcriptomics.
intervention_record: 急性毒性、组织病理与转录组

quote: Key findings include a 96 h LC 50 of 23.17 mg/L, highlighting significant PFOS toxicity.
statement: 主要发现包括96小时LC50为23.17 mg/L，突显了PFOS的显著毒性。
text_zh: 主要发现包括96小时LC50为23.17 mg/L，突显了PFOS的显著毒性。
text_en: Key findings include a 96-hour LC50 of 23.17 mg/L, highlighting the significant toxicity of PFOS.

quote: Histopathological analysis revealed severe liver damage, characterized by nucleolar dissolution, disorganized architecture, lipid accumulation, and hepatocellular vacuolation.
statement: 组织病理学分析揭示了严重的肝脏损伤，其特征是核仁溶解、结构紊乱、脂质积累和肝细胞空泡化。
text_zh: 组织病理学分析揭示了严重的肝脏损伤，其特征是核仁溶解、结构紊乱、脂质积累和肝细胞空泡化。
text_en: Histopathological analysis revealed severe liver damage, characterized by nucleolysis, structural disorder, lipid accumulation, and hepatocyte vacuolation.

quote: Exposure also impacted genes that are critical for endocrine and immune functions, exacerbating liver injury.
statement: 暴露还影响了对于内分泌和免疫功能至关重要的基因，加剧了肝脏损伤。
text_zh: 暴露还影响了对于内分泌和免疫功能至关重要的基因，加剧了肝脏损伤。
text_en: Exposure also affected genes critical for endocrine and immune function, exacerbating liver damage.

quote: Such characteristics also make it an ideal candidate for the infection and subsequent spread of various endoparasitic species, as observed with findings of Protozoa [ 38 ], Monogenea [ 39 ], Digenea [ 35 ], Trematoda [ 35 ], Acanthocephala [ 40 ], and Nematoda [ 4 ], parasites in Prussian carp, including the genus Contracaecum [ 41 ].
statement: Prussian carp的特性使其成为多种内寄生虫（包括原虫、单殖吸虫、复殖吸虫、绦虫、棘头虫和线虫，特别是Contracaecum属）感染和传播的理想宿主。
text_zh: Prussian carp的特性使其成为多种内寄生虫（包括原虫、单殖吸虫、复殖吸虫、绦虫、棘头虫和线虫，特别是Contracaecum属）感染和传播的理想宿主。
text_en: The characteristics of Prussian carp make it an ideal host for the infection and transmission of various internal parasites (including protozoa, monogeneans, digeneans, cestodes, acanthocephalans, and nematodes, especially those of the genus Contracaecum).

quote: The individuals of Prussian carp, infected by the third stage of Contracaecum larvae, could show high zoonotic potential due to their frequent use in recreational and sport fishing, as well as a source of food for humans, making it extremely important to monitor their health [ 34 ].
statement: 受Contracaecum幼虫第三阶段感染的Prussian carp个体因常作为休闲垂钓对象及人类食物来源而具有高的人畜共患病潜力，因此监测其健康状况极为重要。
text_zh: 受Contracaecum幼虫第三阶段感染的Prussian carp个体因常作为休闲垂钓对象及人类食物来源而具有高的人畜共患病潜力，因此监测其健康状况极为重要。
text_en: Prussian carp individuals infected with the third-stage larvae of Contracaecum have high zoonotic potential because they are often targeted for recreational fishing and used as a source of human food, making monitoring their health status extremely important.
outcome: 健康监控与人畜共患病风险

quote: While histological evidence clearly demonstrates liver damage by PFOS in crucian carp, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying this toxicity remain to be fully elucidated.
statement: 虽然组织学证据清楚地表明PFOS对鲫鱼造成肝脏损伤，但导致这种毒性的精确分子机制仍有待完全阐明。
text_zh: 虽然组织学证据清楚地表明PFOS对鲫鱼造成肝脏损伤，但导致这种毒性的精确分子机制仍有待完全阐明。
text_en: Although histological evidence clearly indicates that PFOS causes liver damage in crucian carp, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying this toxicity remain to be fully elucidated.
outcome: 肝脏损伤机制的不确定性
limitations: 分子机制尚未完全阐明

quote: Among these effects, alterations in the immune system appear to be one of the most sensitive health outcomes associated with PFASs exposure.
statement: 在这些影响中，免疫系统的改变似乎是PFAS暴露相关的最敏感的健康结果之一。
text_zh: 在这些影响中，免疫系统的改变似乎是PFAS暴露相关的最敏感的健康结果之一。
text_en: Among these effects, changes in the immune system appear to be one of the most sensitive health outcomes associated with PFAS exposure.

quote: Transcriptome profiling identified 1036 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between control and high-PFOS-exposure groups, with 629 upregulated and 407 downregulated genes.
statement: 转录组谱分析确定了对照组和高PFOS暴露组之间的1036个差异表达基因（DEGs），其中629个上调，407个下调。
text_zh: 转录组谱分析确定了对照组和高PFOS暴露组之间的1036个差异表达基因（DEGs），其中629个上调，407个下调。
text_en: Transcriptome profiling identified 1036 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between the control group and the high PFOS exposure group, of which 629 were upregulated and 407 were downregulated.
